content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2U06 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: identify where Greek is used around the world and recognise that there are many different languages spoken in communities throughout Australia
content_descriptions.sub_strand: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: researching the countries where different languages are spoken and discuss why the world has many different languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing that Greek is spoken in different places in the world apart from Greece and using a globe, printed or digital world map to highlight countries/places and brainstorming why Greek is spoken there

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: watching videos or reading books about different Greek-speaking communities

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing that many languages from different parts of the world are spoken in Australia and may be represented in their classroom, and creating a speech bubble that introduces the students and the language(s) they speak

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing how local names of streets, places and landmarks can have their origins in language(s) of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples and comparing them to the names of some Greek places and landmarks

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPACP1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities of Australia maintain a deep connection to, and responsibility for, Country and Place and have holistic values and belief systems that are connected to the land, sea, sky and waterways.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: showing examples of how gesture and body language are similar to or different in Greek to the language(s) they speak at home

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: learning about the Greek names of foods that they see in Australia in places such as restaurants, cafes or delicatessens, for example, feta, kalamata olives, saganaki, baklava

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that languages and communities have different protocols regarding the use of terms of respect, for example, there are ways of addressing Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples using familial terms (e.g. Uncle, Aunty) depending on the relationship, and comparing these terms with those in Greek and/or other languages

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAP2
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have sophisticated political, economic and social organisation systems, which include but are not limited to family and kinship structures, laws, traditions, customs, land tenure systems and protocols for strong governance and authority.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

curriculum_content_description.strand_title: Engaging with Greek Language and Culture
curriculum_content_description.strand_tag: Engaging with Greek Language and Culture

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2E01 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: notice that Greek looks and sounds different to other languages
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Engaging with Greek Language and Culture

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E01-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing when Greek or English is being used in the classroom (e.g. ‘sandwiching’ a word by saying it in Greek, then in English, and then again in Greek), and talking about Greek words they may use or have heard such as kalamata, tzatziki, feta or haloumi, and English words with a Greek origin such as octopus, dinosaur or zoo

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E01-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: sharing the word for ‘hello’ in languages known to them and identifying how to say ‘hello’ in Greek

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E01-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring the different languages spoken by class members and listening to the different sounds and ways of saying common expressions such as ‘Good morning’ or ‘My name is …’

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E01-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: experimenting with sounds that are unique to Greek, such as γ in γάτα, ξ in ξύλο and ψ in ψάρι, imitating the shape of the teacher’s mouth and the sounds they produce

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E01-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that Greek uses the Greek alphabet, unlike English, and focusing on the letters that look the same and the ones that are different

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E01-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing that an accent mark is used in Greek words of more than one syllable and that it assists in reading the word accurately

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E01-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: singing familiar nursery rhymes such as ‘Incy wincy spider’, ‘Head, shoulders, knees and toes’, and ‘Twinkle, twinkle, little star’ in Greek and discovering that even though the songs may have the same lyrics in English, they can sound different when sung in Greek

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E01-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing their names in Greek, English or other known languages and making comparisons regarding number of letters, shape of letters and similar sounds, using some basic terms such as letters, words and capital letters

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E01-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing words that have similar pronunciation in Greek and English, for example, μπανάνα, μαμά, καφέ, βάζο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E01-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: playing with and using tactile materials to create Greek letters, for example, forming letters using plasticine; chalk writing on the pavement; painting with water; making pictures out of letters to be displayed in the classroom

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2E02 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: develop oral language skills through exploring and listening to the sounds and patterns of the language
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Engaging with Greek Language and Culture

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E02-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring the Greek alphabet through experiences such as circle chants to a beat or rhythm, and songs with movement and actions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E02-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: mimicking the sounds and rhythms of Greek and noticing differences/similarities to their own language(s)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E02-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to and repeating onomatopoeia, for example, using the sounds γαβ (woof), κο κο κο (cluck cluck cluck), νιάου (miaow), μου (moo), and comparing these sounds with animal sounds in English and other languages represented in the class

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E02-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: observing the position of the tongue and shape of mouth when pronouncing Greek sounds (e.g. the trilled r; the 4 single vowel sounds α, ε, ι, ο) and comparing them with English

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E02-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: reproducing the sounds and rhythms of the Greek language by reciting, repeating after, and imitating the teacher, through choral repetition or chants, recording their own voice on a digital device and listening to their recording

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E02-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: engaging with new sets of vocabulary by making concrete associations with them, such as touching and identifying colours in the classroom or touching and identifying toy animals and naming them

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E02-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to and singing Greek songs, for example, «Αχ Κουνελάκι», «Η Γιαγιά Μου η Καλή», and then viewing Greek song videos and joining in or repeating the words

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E02-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in Greek versions of children’s songs and rhymes, identifying some similarities and differences compared with English versions, for example, key words or a tune such as «Το δαχτυλίδι», «Ένα, δύο, τρία κουνελάκια», «Πέντε παπάκια», «Η μικρή αράχνη»

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E02-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: playing games using familiar objects or words in Greek, for example, creating a matching game to match Greek words with pictures or objects, saying the words aloud as they match

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E02-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: playing class games, for example, Το δαχτυλίδι, Σκυλάκι, σκυλάκι ποιος έχει το κοκαλάκι

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2E03 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: recognise and respond to greetings, instructions and language relating to their personal world using one- or 2-word responses and/or single-idea phrases
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Engaging with Greek Language and Culture

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E03-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using common greetings and gestures relevant to the time of day, for example, καλημέρα, καλησπέρα, καληνύχτα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E03-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: responding to images showing different times of the day, greeting others at different times of the day, and verbalising which greeting is most appropriate and why

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E03-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in everyday routines such as saying the day, weather and how they are, responding to the class roll call and instructions, or expressing thanks, for example, Σήμερα είναι Δευτέρα, κάνει κρύο, είμαι καλά, δεν είμαι καλά, Ελάτε μέσα, Κλείσε την πόρτα, Κάτσε κάτω, Σήκω πάνω

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E03-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using non-verbal ways of communicating and showing understanding in interactions such as gestures, body language and facial expressions, for example, a nod of their head; hand gestures; eye contact; thumbs up

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E03-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing the use of titles to address the teacher and first names or surnames to address adults to show respect, for example, κύριε Νίκο, κυρία Ελένη, κυρία Παπαδοπούλου

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E03-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using simple, modelled language to introduce themselves, for example, Γεια σας, Με λένε …, Είμαι … χρονών

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E03-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: naming family members, friends and pets using props such as photographs, pictures, puppets or soft toys, for example, Η μαμά μου, ο μπαμπάς μου, η γάτα μου

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E03-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using modelled language to express simple likes using keywords, props, pictures and authentic resources, for example, Μου αρέσει το κόκκινο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E03-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to, and responding, using modelled language, when playing class games, for example, in ‘I spy’ saying Βλέπω κάτι που αρχίζει με … or playing Πάπια, πάπια, χήνα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E03-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using Greek phrases for everyday interactions such as thanking and apologising (e.g. Ευχαριστώ, Συγγνώμη) or on special occasions such as birthdays or other celebrations, for example, Χρόνια πολλά, Καλά Χριστούγεννα

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2E04 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: explore connections between language and culture through play and/or imagination
substrand_content_descriptions.strand: Engaging with Greek Language and Culture

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E04-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: acknowledging and celebrating the language and cultural diversity of others, for example, listening to the different sounds and ways of saying common expressions or celebrating different events

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E04-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in whole-class discussions about the meaning of ‘culture’ and ‘identity’, talking about their traditions, practices and what is important to them and their way of life

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E04-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that Greek is another language and understanding that it is spoken by people in Greece as well as other countries, including Australia

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E04-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying items such as food and architecture in Australian culture that come from Greece, for example, souvlaki, saganaki, the Shrine of Remembrance

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E04-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: accessing multimodal texts to explore cultural identity, customs and practices and responding to these in a variety of ways, for example, watching a video of children flying kites on Clean Monday (the first day of Lent) and learning vocabulary such as Καθαρά Δευτέρα, χαρταετός

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E04-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: engaging actively in, and sharing the enjoyment of, language, culture and texts in a range of ways, for example, listening and responding to stories, cultural displays and experiences

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E04-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: celebrating holidays and festivals such as May Day and Easter and exploring associated traditions and languages, for example, creating May Day wreaths and decorating Easter candles while learning Greek words (e.g. Πρωτομαγιά, στεφάνι, Πάσχα, λαμπάδα)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E04-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing different activities and food enjoyed during special celebrations such as Easter and learning simple words and phrases, for example, κουλουράκια, κόκκινα αυγά, Καλό Πάσχα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E04-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using their imagination to immerse themselves in a cultural experience by participating in role-plays of various cultural activities, for example, attending a name day celebration or christening and practising using associated language, such as Χρόνια πολλά, Να σας ζήσει

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2E04-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: learning about the importance of Greek dancing in Greek culture and celebrations, and learning some dances, for example, Καλαματιανό

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2C01 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: communicate using formulaic and modelled language relating to aspects of their personal world

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C01-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using greetings depending on the time of day and relationship to the other person, for example, Γεια σου or Τι κάνεις with peers; Γεια σας or Τι κάνετε when speaking with adults

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C01-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: following instructions and directions, for example, σήκω, σηκωθείτε, έλα, ελάτε, ελάτε μέσα, καθίστε, Έλα εδώ, Πήγαινε έξω, Κλείσε την πόρτα, Σβήσε το φως

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C01-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in routine exchanges such as opening and closing of lessons (e.g. Καλημέρα παιδιά, Χαίρετε κυρία), responding to the class roll call, (e.g. εδώ, λείπει) and moving between activities (e.g. Ελάτε, Καθίστε)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C01-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: responding to and using formulaic expressions in everyday classroom-related situations, for example, ορίστε, ευχαριστώ, παρακαλώ, Δεν ξέρω, Πώς είσαι; Είμαι καλά, Εσύ; Καλά, Τι κάνετε; Έτσι κι έτσι, Εσείς and incorporating intonation and appropriate gestures and body language

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C01-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using some Greek expressions and spontaneous exclamations when interacting with peers, for example, πω πω, έλα, γρήγορα, σταμάτα, μη μιλάς, μη μιλάτε, όπα! μπράβο! and noticing differences in the use of language, voice or body language

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C01-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: asking to borrow items and expressing possession of belongings, for example, Θέλω μολύβι, έχω βιβλίο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C01-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising and responding to questions about themselves, for example, Πώς σε λένε;, Με λένε …, Σου αρέσει η λεμονάδα;, Ναι μου αρέσει, Όχι

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C01-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: introducing themselves and other important people in their lives to others, for example, Με λένε …, Εσένα; /Εσάς; Εσένα πώς σε λένε; Να η μαμά μου

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C01-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using modelled sentences and/or supporting gestures to communicate informally about likes, dislikes and favourite possessions, for example, Σου αρέσει …; Ναι, Όχι, lifting head/eyebrows to answer ‘no’, hand action to show Έτσι κι έτσι, lifting head and shoulders to convey not knowing something

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2C02 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: participate in a range of guided language activities using formulaic expressions, and visual and spoken cues

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C02-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: singing and engaging in activities that include rhymes, action songs, lullabies and counting songs, for example, Γύρω, γύρω, γύρω, μέσα, μέσα, μέσα … έξω, έξω, έξω, Κεφάλι, χέρια, πόδια, Ένα, δύο, τρία κουνελάκια, Πάνω τα χεράκια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C02-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in show-and-tell or a presentation about a favourite item using simple language, for example, Να η κούκλα μου. Τη λένε …

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C02-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: collaborating with peers in activities such as a guided role-play or labelling items using modelled language, for example, ορίστε, ευχαριστώ, παρακαλώ, Είμαι έξι, Να η οικογένειά μου, Να η φίλη μου, Να ο σκύλος μου, Τον λένε Δία

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C02-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: playing a range of games using secure digital tools and applications to reinforce vocabulary (e.g. playing matching pairs, filling in gaps, drag-and-drop, memory games, bingo), using visual and spoken cues and formulaic expressions such as Να το, το βρήκα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C02-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: taking turns in games and action songs using the repetitive language Σειρά σου, Έλα Άννα, and songs such as «Περνά περνά η μέλισσα», «Γύρω γύρω όλοι»

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C02-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: contributing to and using classroom resources to aid the learning of Greek, for example, a picture dictionary, photo wall, word wall, classroom routines/greetings poster

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C02-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using the Greek alphabet and numerals with support to ‘crack the code’ and solve a puzzle or problem, or lead students to a location individually or in groups

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C02-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: interacting with a character or puppet in an imaginary situation or setting, using gestures to communicate informally, for example, Πού είναι ο Σπότ; Τι κάνει ο Σποτ;

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C02-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: performing a traditional dance to an audience using modelled language and exclamations, clapping and gestures, for example, Παλαμάκια, Όπα, Πω πω

strand_substrands.substrand_title: Mediating meaning in and between languages
strand_substrands.substrand_tag: Mediating meaning in and between languages

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2C03 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: locate key information in a variety of texts with support, and respond using gestures, images, words and/or formulaic phrases
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C03-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening for keywords and expressions in stories, rhymes or songs, using visual, non-verbal and spoken cues to respond in a variety of ways, for example, μου αρέσει, δε μου αρέσει

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C03-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: demonstrating comprehension of ideas in simple spoken, written, and multimodal texts through actions such as labelling, matching, drawing, onscreen pointing, clicking or dragging

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C03-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: responding to questions about characters, places and objects that elicit details such as characteristics, size, colour, shape and quantity, for example, Να ο λύκος, Eίναι κακός

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C03-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: grouping vocabulary (word cards and/or images) into sets, such as classroom items or animals

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C03-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: sorting and categorising information using simple graphic organisers such as graphs, mind maps or tables, for example, recording likes and dislikes; masculine, feminine and neuter words; pets at home

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C03-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in shared reading of imaginative and informative texts, and making predictions about the storyline and characters using cues from the heading, symbols, pictures and words in the text, or answering questions related to key information

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C03-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: performing songs, chants and rhymes in response to an imaginative digital or online text (e.g. Η πολύ πεινασμένη κάμπια), experimenting with different expressive effects such as different voices, or using simple gestures such as a hand action to show Πω πω!

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C03-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to, reading, or viewing a story and sequencing the events and ideas using storyboards, drawing pictures and adding captions, or cutting and pasting pictures/words in order

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C03-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: watching a video and noticing hand gestures, intonation patterns, facial expressions and body language that accompany Greek language and interactions, for example, formal/informal greetings; when introducing or instructing; when expressing preferences and feelings

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2C04 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: explore and make meaning from sounds, words and phrases for familiar objects or terms in Greek through play, and discover how languages influence each other
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C04-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: playing games using familiar objects or words in Greek, for example, creating a matching game to match Greek words with pictures or objects, saying the words aloud as they match

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C04-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in Greek versions of children’s songs and rhymes, identifying some similarities and differences compared with English versions, for example, key words or a tune such as, Το δαχτυλίδι, Ένα, δύο, τρία κουνελάκια, Πέντε παπάκια, Η μικρή αράχνη

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C04-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing words that have similar pronunciation in Greek and English, for example, μπανάνα, μαμά, καφέ, βάζο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C04-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing the cultural meaning in some expressions or phrases such as χρόνια πολλά, which can be used for any celebration or occasion, for example, birthdays, name days, Christmas

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C04-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: talking about Greek words they may use or have heard such as kalamata, tzatziki, feta or haloumi, and English words with Greek origin such as octopus, dinosaur, zoo

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C04-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding that particular Australian English terms and expressions have no equivalent in Greek, for example, ‘billabong’, ‘corroboree’, ‘the bush’, and some Greek terms and expressions have no English equivalent, for example, φιλότιμο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C04-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using Greek words, expressions and exclamations when playing and conversing with one another, for example, Όχι!, Ναι!, Επιτυχία!, and noticing and comparing body language and tone when using English

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C04-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using culturally appropriate language in different settings, for example, to show politeness and respect, γεια σου/γεια σας, Nα’ σαι καλά, Να’στε καλά

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C04-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: engaging in different Greek cultural practices or traditional activities held at different times of the year, and linking them with classroom-related vocabulary, for example, decorating λαμπάδες for Easter, making flower wreaths for Πρωτομαγιά, wishing someone a Χρόνια πολλά, greeting others on different occasions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C04-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: performing in role-plays such as purchasing fruits and vegetables, or acting as a character from a familiar story

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2C05 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: create spoken and written texts using words, familiar phrases and modelled language

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C05-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using familiar vocabulary and modelled sentence structures to create informative texts about self, family, friends and possessions, such as a spoken or written description, class book, family tree or dialogue, for example, Ο αδελφός μου είναι ψηλός, Η αδερφή μου είναι είκοσι χρονών, Το σκυλί μου είναι μαύρο, Το υπνοδωμάτιό μου …

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C05-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: role-playing their favourite characters or events from familiar shared storybooks such as Mr Archimedes’ bath, and making simple statements in Greek, for example, Είμαι η Πέππα, Πάω στο γιατρό, Ο κύριος Αρχιμήδης κάνει μπάνιο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C05-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying self as belonging to family, class or peer/community groups and representing these relationships through drawing pictures or adding captions to photos, for example, ο φίλος μου, η τάξη μας, η οικεγένειά μου

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C05-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating and illustrating class ‘big books’ about familiar topics using simple modelled structures, for example, writing and drawing favourite animals, using words such as ο σκύλος and το άλογο, and practising reading the words aloud

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C05-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: reading or viewing multimodal stories and completing activities such as ‘Beginning, Middle, End’ flip books, drawing a picture to represent what happens in the 3 sections of the story, then writing a short description under each image (with the teacher scribing for younger students)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C05-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a print or digital glossary of new Greek words and phrases with accompanying drawings, pictures or photos, for example, creating a collage or booklet of parts of the body and labelling them

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C05-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating stories, rhymes and songs through drawings or digital tools using simple or complex sentences and captions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C05-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a display wall with pictures and captions retelling the main events from the images of a class excursion or event

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C05-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating and presenting bilingual ‘big books’, storyboards or digital texts based on a variety of real or imagined scenarios in familiar contexts, adding images and captions, for example, Τα τρία γουρουνάκια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2C05-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: making bilingual greeting cards for celebrations (e.g. Ημέρα της μητέρας, γενέθλια, Πάσχα) using quotes (e.g. καλό Πάσχα, Χαρούμενη γιορτή της μητέρας μαμά, χρόνια πολλά), alongside equivalent English greetings where culturally appropriate

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2U01 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: imitate the pronunciation and intonation of spoken Greek, and understand how sounds of the Greek alphabet are produced and represented

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U01-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: building phonic awareness by pronouncing alphabet letters with familiar sounds (e.g. Οο, Ιι, Εε, Αα, Κκ, Ττ, Λλ, Ππ, Σσς, Μμ, Νν, Ηη, Υυ, Ωω, Ββ, Ζζ, Φφ), and building to more unfamiliar sounds (e.g. Γγ, Ρρ, Δδ, Θθ, Ξξ, Ψψ, Χx) in activities such as flashcard chants, for example, Αα-άλογο, Γγ-γάτα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U01-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that most duplicated consonants in a word sound the same as the single consonants (e.g. κόκκινο, Ελλάδα, άλλο, εννέα, ΄Αννα), and locating and highlighting the double consonants in words or texts

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U01-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding that duplicating the letter γ (γγ) changes it to a hard ‘g’ sound and practising saying words containing this sound or playing a ‘correct the teacher’ game (correcting a mispronunciation when the teacher reads the words or a short text aloud)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U01-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: imitating the sounds, rhythms, intonation and stress of Greek, using hand gestures and non-verbal cues to assist learning

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U01-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: locating and highlighting specific alphabet letters and accent marks in names, or identifying vowels or consonants within words

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U01-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing pronunciation, intonation and pace by singing, reciting and repeating the names of letters in the alphabet, for example, in the alphabet song or when referring to a letter in a word

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U01-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising and making simple syllables from consonant–vowel combinations (e.g. μα, με, μη, μι, μο, μυ, μω) and understanding that syllables can be joined together to make words such as α-λά-τι and μά-τι

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U01-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: clapping out syllables of words

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U01-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and pronouncing the most common digraphs/diphthongs, including μπ as in μπαμπάς and ου as in μου, in activities such as shared reading, ‘spot the digraph’ or games (e.g. bingo, digraph scavenger hunt)

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2U02 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: identify sound combinations to produce simple words, and then an increasing number of frequently used words and phrases

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring the Greek alphabet through learning experiences such as alphabet blocks, card games and flashcard letter/sound chants

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: learning the letters of the alphabet and the sounds they represent in activities, for example, forming the shapes of letters using playdough; using playdough to make things that start with a focus letter, then playing letter games such as bingo

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: underlining graphemes, syllables or rhyming words in short texts or poems, or recognising the syllables in words and identifying the number of syllables in a word, for example, Τετάρτη (Τε-τάρ-τη) has 3 syllables

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: studying compound words and learning their meanings, for example, καλημέρα is formed from the words καλή and μέρα and means ‘good day’

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using high-frequency verbs in a variety of contexts and completing word searches for frequently used words, starting with easy words and then moving on to gradually more challenging ones

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that all nouns in Greek, in particular names, have an article and gender, for example, ο μπαμπάς, η Άννα, το σκυλί

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing that adjectives have gender, for example, o κόκκινος, η κόκκινη, το κόκκινο, o μεγάλος, η μεγάλη, το μεγάλο, o καλός, η καλή, το καλό

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using simple adverbs to show location (e.g. calling out the adverb that identifies the location of a class item), for example, έξω, μέσα, εδώ, εκεί, πάνω, κάτω, γύρω

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing how simple adjectives and adverbs enhance sentences, for example, comparing sentences with and without adjectives or adverbs such as Κάνει λίγο κρύο, Σ’ αγαπώ πολύ μαμά!, Το σπίτι είναι πολύ μεγάλο, η μικρή βάρκα, η μεγάλη βάρκα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using verbs in the first person to describe aspects of themselves when writing a simple profile or telling the class about themselves, for example, Είμαι αγόρι, είμαι έξι, έχω γάτα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E11 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising terms for common, everyday nouns in activities such as ‘Spot the item’, where students locate given items in photos/pictures related to topics being studied, for example, η πόρτα, η καρέκλα, οι καρέκλες, το σπίτι, τα σπίτια, o μπαμπάς

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E12 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: responding to and issuing commands, for example, έλα εδώ!, κάτσε κάτω!

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E13 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: responding to questions that include verbs in the second person, singular or plural, such as Πόσω / ν χρονών είσαι; Τι κάνετε;

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E14 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing number knowledge and using numbers in modelled sentences, for example, Είμαι έξι

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U02-E15 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: beginning to use conjunctions such as και to link simple ideas

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2U03 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: recognise and explore how the Greek alphabet and features of language are used to construct meaning in Greek

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U03-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding that the 26 letters of the Roman alphabet have connections with the Ancient Greek alphabet, and comparing lower-case and upper-case Modern Greek and Roman alphabet letters

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U03-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: becoming familiar with the Greek alphabet, noticing similarities to and differences from English and/or other languages by saying and/or singing the alphabet and discussing similarities and differences in the sounds, for example, γ, δ, ν, ξ, ψ, ω

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U03-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: experimenting with the formation of Greek letters with hands-on play to recreate them using playdough, found objects, writing in sand, big brushes and water on concrete

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U03-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying target letters in words through games and activities, for example, locating all the β in a particular word or phrase and calling out Το βρήκα or Βρήκα δύο when they locate them

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U03-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: tracing and writing letters and words or sentences to practise correct letter formation

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2U04 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: identify that written and spoken Greek has grammatical structures and other language features that may be similar to or different from English and/or other languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U04-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding that there are many words and names in English that have Greek origins, for example, Alex, Chloe, Timothy, Theodore, Zoe, alphabet, astronaut, chemist, dentist, echidna, platypus, eucalyptus, hippopotamus, mathematics, school, story, telephone

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U04-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing sentence-level punctuation such as capitalisation of names, question marks and the use of the accent mark to indicate emphasis, for example, ο σκύλος, η γάτα, το βιβλίο, Σ’ αρέσει να παίζεις ποδόσφαιρο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U04-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing similar texts in Greek and English or other languages and noticing how they are the same or different, for example, a counting song, street signs, labels at a market

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U04-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using an anchor chart for cognates and words with Greek roots and adding to it throughout the year, for example, αλφάβητο, βάζο, Σεπτέμβριος, σαλάτα, λεμόνι, μπανάνα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U04-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising the order of words in phrases and sentences, for example, η μαμά μου, Δεν κάνει κρύο, Nα η θεία μου, and making comparisons with English sentence structure

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U04-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing that certain sounds in English do not exist in Greek, for example, noticing sounds when writing their names and other familiar words such as ‘a’ (α as in Katerina/Κατερίνα), the hard ‘d’ (ντ as in tomato/ντομάτα), ‘b’ (μπ as in dad/μπαμπάς), ‘j’ (τζ as in glass/τζάμι)

strand_substrands.substrand_title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture
strand_substrands.substrand_tag: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2U05 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: reflect on how language, culture and identity are interconnected and discuss how Greek-speaking communities are similar to or different from others
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U05-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing non-verbal forms of communicating with each other in Greek, English and/or other languages such as ways of greeting, and how body language can be used to express agreement, disagreement, preferences, feelings and emotions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U05-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing aspects of their own and Greek-speaking children’s lifestyles, family interactions and celebrations, for example, daily greetings, main meal of the day and associated language such as ορίστε, καλή όρεξη

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U05-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying terms, concepts and symbols that can be used to help understand and discuss culture, for example, flags, food, national costumes, the owl as a symbol of education, famous buildings and treasures, national emblems, sporting emblems/jumpers

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U05-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying symbols and colours used by Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples and by Greek-speaking communities in a range of contexts, for example, identifying the colours of flags in Greek and discussing what the colours represent in English

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPACP1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities of Australia maintain a deep connection to, and responsibility for, Country and Place and have holistic values and belief systems that are connected to the land, sea, sky and waterways.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U05-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring the significance of different Greek cultural practices, activities and games, for example, using a κομπολόι; making red-and-white Μαρτάκια bracelets for March; flower wreaths for Πρωτομαγιά (1 May); making masks or kites for Clean Monday

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U05-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing a short video clip and recognising that words and behaviours may reflect aspects of culture and identity, for example, γλέντι, κέφι, χρόνια πολλά, όπα!, and that it may be hard to explain their meaning or capture the full essence in English

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U05-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in an ‘Ancient Greek Day’ with invited guests, assisting in the preparation of some traditional Ancient Greek food, or participating in a mini Olympics, using and teaching related vocabulary and presenting winners with a laurel wreath

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U05-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: demonstrating understanding that language changes according to the audience, for example, language used to greet elders, parents or carers is more respectful than greetings used for friends

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U05-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: engaging in a whole-class discussion about the differences between each student’s own culture and Greek culture, sharing insights about how they celebrate events such as Christmas, New Year or other holidays

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG2U06 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: identify where Greek is used around the world and recognise that there are many different languages spoken in communities throughout Australia
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: researching the countries where different languages are spoken and discuss why the world has many different languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing that Greek is spoken in different places in the world apart from Greece and using a globe, printed or digital world map to highlight countries/places and brainstorming why Greek is spoken there

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: watching videos or reading books about different Greek-speaking communities

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing that many languages from different parts of the world are spoken in Australia and may be represented in their classroom, and creating a speech bubble that introduces the students and the language(s) they speak

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing how local names of streets, places and landmarks can have their origins in language(s) of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples and comparing them to the names of some Greek places and landmarks

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPACP1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities of Australia maintain a deep connection to, and responsibility for, Country and Place and have holistic values and belief systems that are connected to the land, sea, sky and waterways.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: showing examples of how gesture and body language are similar to or different in Greek to the language(s) they speak at home

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: learning about the Greek names of foods that they see in Australia in places such as restaurants, cafes or delicatessens, for example, feta, kalamata olives, saganaki, baklava

elaborations.name: VC2LMG2U06-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that languages and communities have different protocols regarding the use of terms of respect, for example, there are ways of addressing Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples using familial terms (e.g. Uncle, Aunty) depending on the relationship, and comparing these terms with those in Greek and/or other languages

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAP2
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have sophisticated political, economic and social organisation systems, which include but are not limited to family and kinship structures, laws, traditions, customs, land tenure systems and protocols for strong governance and authority.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

field_grouped_levels_per_subject.name: Modern Greek Levels 3 and 4 (Curriculum F–10 Sequence)

curriculum_band_description.body:
In Levels 3 and 4, Greek language learning builds on each student’s prior learning and experiences with language. Students communicate and work in collaboration with their peers and teachers through purposeful and creative play in structured activities that involve listening, speaking, reading, writing and viewing. They use Greek to interact with their peers and teachers and to participate in activities in familiar settings that reflect their interests and capabilities. They use local and digital resources to explore Greek-speaking communities. They continue to receive extensive support through modelling, scaffolding and repetition, as well as the use of targeted resources.  

Students develop active listening skills and use gestures, words and modelled expressions, imitating the sounds, pronunciation and intonation of Greek. They locate information, respond to and create texts using written and spoken Greek. They access authentic and purpose-developed Greek-language texts such as picture books, stories, songs, digital and animated games, timetables, recipes and advertisements. They recognise the interconnected nature of language, culture and identity.

curriculum_achievement_standard.body:
By the end of Level 4, students use Greek to initiate structured interactions and share information related to the classroom and their personal worlds. They use modelled language to participate in spoken and written activities. They locate and respond to key items of information in texts, using strategies to help interpret and convey meaning in familiar contexts. They use modelled language and basic grammatical structures to create texts.

Students imitate the sound combinations and rhythms of spoken Greek. They demonstrate their understanding that Greek has non-verbal, spoken and written language conventions and rules to convey meaning. They recognise that some terms have cultural meanings. They identify patterns in Greek and make comparisons between Greek and English, using simple metalanguage. They understand how aspects of language and culture contribute to their own and others’ identity.

as_extracts.name: LMGF104-E01
as_extracts.description: students use Greek to initiate structured interactions and share information related to the classroom and their personal worlds.

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4C01 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: initiate exchanges and respond to modelled questions about themselves, others and the classroom environment, using formulaic expressions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: selecting formal/informal greetings for real or simulated situations, depending on the time of day and relationship to the other person, for example, Καλημέρα φίλε, Καλησπέρα κύριε Χρήστο or Καληνύχτα μαμά, and using first names when greeting friends, but adding a salutation when addressing adults, for example, Γεια σας κυρία Βάσω, Τι κάνετε κύριε Δημήτρη;

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: initiating conversations using modelled words, phrases or spontaneous interjections, for example, Α καλά, έτσι μπράβο, έλα, Πω πω!, Ωραία!, Όπα!

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: describing features, characteristics and locations of things or places, for example, Πού είναι η κόλλα; Βρίσκεται στο γραφείο του δασκάλου

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: asking for permission and requesting help using formulaic phrases (e.g. θέλω βοήθεια, ελάτε κυρία, δεν καταλαβαίνω), or asking how to say or write a word or expression (e.g. Πώς το λένε)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: requesting information from others using modelled sentences, for example, Πού είναι ο κύριος Βασίλης; Να τος., Πού είναι η δασκάλα;, Τι ώρα είναι; Είναι μία η ώρα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in class surveys and graphing activities about family members, and asking and responding to questions such as Πόσα αδέρφια έχεις; Έχω δύο αδερφές

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: exchanging simple correspondence with peers, such as notes, invitations or birthday cards in print or digital form

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: playing speaking games (e.g. I spy and What am I?) using formulaic opening statements such as Βλέπω κάτι που αρχίζει με κάπα, Έχω τέσσερα πόδια, μία ουρά …, and responses such as κόλλα, καρέκλα, είσαι γάτα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: responding to questions about daily and classroom routines, for example, Πού είναι το φως;, Nα το., Πού είναι ο Τάκης; Nα τος., Πού είναι η Άννα; Nα τη., Τι μέρα είναι σήμερα; Σήμερα είναι Δευτέρα., Τι καιρό κάνει σήμερα; Κάνει κρύο / Bρέχει /, Δε βρέχει /, Ούτε κρύο, ούτε ζέστη

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4C02 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: participate in activities that involve expressing interests and exchanging information, using a range of familiar phrases and modelled structures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using appropriate body language and gestures in response to enquiries, for example, ναι, μ’αρέσει, δε μ’αρέσει, understanding that lifting the head means ‘no’ and is used only in informal situations

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: planning, rehearsing and performing an item for an audience such as school assembly, another class or parents, and delegating roles and responsibilities

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: following simple procedures and using familiar phrases and modelled structures for shared activities, for example, following a recipe and naming ingredients to make κουλουράκια, λουκουμάδες, τηγανίτες or φρουτοσαλάτα, following instructions in a craft activity to make a kite for Καθαρή Δευτέρα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in a role-play or skit (e.g. buying goods from an ελληνική αγορά), using props (e.g. Καραγκιόζη or Τάκη the bear) to engage in conversation, for example, Πόσο κάνει το γάλα; Δύο δολλάρια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: engaging in group games such as snap, Simon says, memory, matching cards, or a ball game, praising and encouraging peers, and taking turns, for example, μπράβο σου, ωραία, προσπάθησε, έλα, σειρά μου, σειρά σου

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: taking turns in pairs to assist the teacher with classroom tasks and responsibilities, for example, roll call, distributing/collecting work, giving basic instructions such as Λείπει ο Γιάννης, Είναι άρρωστος, ορίστε, γράψτε and διαβάστε

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: engaging in shared reading activities where students access information from the text to help them make meaning, identifying relevant language features, discussing unfamiliar vocabulary, and thinking critically about the text, for example, ‘Fact or opinion?’, where they read statements about the text and decide whether it is a fact or an opinion

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: collaborating with peers to plan for and complete tasks such as designing a poster or invitation for a significant event (e.g. 25η Μαρτίου, Aπόκριες) or a class party, and deciding what items to bring, for example, Θα φέρω γλυκό, θα φέρω σαλάτα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: performing simple stories or known fairytales in reader’s theatre activities, demonstrating expression when reading their part

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in cooking or craft activities and using modelled structures to sequence information or write simple procedural texts, for example, recipes or instructions where familiar phrases are used such as ανακάτεψε το αλεύρι με τη ζάχαρη, δίπλωσε το χαρτί στη μέση
