elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: collaborating with peers to plan for and complete tasks such as designing a poster or invitation for a significant event (e.g. 25η Μαρτίου, Aπόκριες) or a class party, and deciding what items to bring, for example, Θα φέρω γλυκό, θα φέρω σαλάτα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: performing simple stories or known fairytales in reader’s theatre activities, demonstrating expression when reading their part

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in cooking or craft activities and using modelled structures to sequence information or write simple procedural texts, for example, recipes or instructions where familiar phrases are used such as ανακάτεψε το αλεύρι με τη ζάχαρη, δίπλωσε το χαρτί στη μέση

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4C05 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: create and present spoken and written texts using formulaic expressions, simple phrases and sentences, and modelled textual conventions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: learning songs related to topics being studied, for example, celebrations such as Christmas and singing Christmas carols in front of an audience (e.g. other classes, parents, grandparents)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: completing cut up or jumbled sentence activities where students move word cards around and manipulate the words to create sentences in proper order

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating spoken, written, print or digital texts using formulaic expressions, simple phrases and sentences to describe family, peers, friends, objects or their favourite pets/animals, for example, Να ο Τάσος, Είναι δέκα χρονών, Του αρέσει να παίζει τένις, Είναι από την Ελλάδα, Μένει στην Αδελαΐδα, Το σπίτι μου, Να η κουζίνα, Να το μπάνιο, Να το αρνάκι, Είναι μικρό

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a class profile using information collected from peers (e.g. creating a chart or database to identify favourite sports, food or colours), for example, το μπάσκετ, το ποδόσφαιρο, το παστίτσιο, η κοτόσουπα, άσπρο, κόκκινο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating and exchanging simple correspondence such as bilingual greeting cards, notes, invitations or messages, in print or digital form

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating simple descriptions in Greek and matching them to appropriate Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Country or Place in their local area or elsewhere in Australia

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPACP1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities of Australia maintain a deep connection to, and responsibility for, Country and Place and have holistic values and belief systems that are connected to the land, sea, sky and waterways.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: presenting information on events or topics of possible interest to children of their own age in Greek-speaking communities, using multimodal resources and authentic materials such as menus, recipes, invitations, instructions, artefacts, brochures or maps

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating and performing simple imaginative texts, switching between Greek and English to enhance meaning, and using dance, singing, movement or drama to animate characters and to give expression to events in texts, for example, acting out scenes from a story; adopting the profile of a character such as Theseus, the Minotaur, Icarus, Hercules, Cyclops or Persephone

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: modifying texts with their own creative input, for example, substituting words or characters (e.g. with an animal, Greek food) in a well-known song, story or procedure, such as «Η Mικρή Ελένη», «Χρόνια πολλά», Η πολύ πεινασμένη κάμπια, or modifying a recipe with alternative ingredients

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using scaffolded textual conventions by creating a new story, for example, in the form of a digital picture book; using favourite characters from imaginative texts such as Ηρακλής or Σποτ, and adding captions using formulaic expressions and modelled language such as Μια φορά και έναν καιρό, Τέλος, Και ζήσαν αυτοί καλά κι εμείς καλύτερα

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4U02 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: recognise and use modelled language, formulaic phrases, simple grammatical structures and language conventions to convey meaning

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying appropriate punctuation marks such as full stops, commas, exclamation marks and question marks, when reading and/or writing a range of texts, and using the accent mark appropriately in Greek when reading or writing, for pronunciation as well as meaning

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying nouns (e.g. highlighting nouns in sentences or reading texts), and recognising singular and plural noun endings in shared reading and writing activities, for example, o σκύλος, οι σκύλοι, η γάτα, οι γάτες, το σπίτι, τα σπίτια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying whether given nouns are singular or plural by sorting singular and plural words into piles or writing nouns from a text into the correct columns, and then changing given nouns to singular or plural

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing the use of gender in Greek nouns, singular/plural and articles (e.g. ο μπαμπάς, η Άννα, η γάτα, οι γάτες, το νερό, τα ψάρια) when reading and/or using them in grammar activities (e.g. noun, verb or adjective hunt), changing the noun to plural form, changing nouns to plural in sentences and modifying the verb as needed, for example, το πουλί πετάει-τα πουλιά πετούν

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and categorising nouns as masculine, feminine or neuter during shared reading of a text, for example, Ο μπαμπάς διαβάζει το βιβλίο- ο μπαμπάς (masculine), Η θεία πήγε ταξίδι στην Αφρική - η Αφρική (feminine), το βιβλίο (neuter)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding and using adjectives to describe characteristics or qualities of a person, place or object, for example, τρία μικρά γουρουνάκια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that adjective endings determine the gender and must agree with the noun (e.g. καλός καφές, καλή μαμά, καλό παιδάκι, ψηλός άντρας, ψηλή κοπέλα, ψηλό δέντρο, άσπρος πίνακας), in activities such as ‘spot the mistake’ grammar exercises, silly sentence and build-a-sentence tasks

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using modelled language and formulaic phrases when participating in oral practice exercises, such as timed pair practice, sentence starters and finish the sentence

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating simple sentences in the subject+verb+object order, for example, Το βάζο έχει λουλούδια, To όνομά μου είναι …

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using familiar verbs in sentences, for example, η γάτα τρέχει, το παιδί τρώει, η μαμά γελά, έλα μπαμπά, ελάτε μέσα, άνοιξε την πόρτα, έχω στυλό

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E11 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: experimenting with compound sentences using conjunctions such as και and αλλά, during sentence-writing activities where students combine 2 simple sentences

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E12 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using some adverbs of place, degree and certainty (e.g. έξω, μέσα, πάνω, κάτω, μπροστά, πίσω, δίπλα, γύρω, λίγο, πολύ, ναι, μάλιστα, όχι, δε(ν), μη(ν)) and some modelled use of adverbs of time (e.g. σήμερα, αύριο, χτες) in activities such as sentence building, or writing instructions, procedures or directions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E13 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding that some words can mean different things in different contexts, for example, μπάνιο can mean ‘bathroom’, ‘bathtub’ or ‘swimming at the beach’

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E14 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: expressing negation in simple sentences, for example, Όχι, δεν το θέλω, δε μ’ αρέσει, κάνει κρύο/δεν κάνει κρύο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E15 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: expanding counting ability to larger numbers, in context and with support, such as έχω εκατό δολλάρια, and using numbers to tell the time, for example, Είναι μία η ώρα

as_extracts.name: LMGF104-E03
as_extracts.description: They locate and respond to key items of information in texts, using strategies to help interpret and convey meaning in familiar contexts.

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4C03 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: locate and respond to key information related to familiar content obtained from spoken, written, viewed and multimodal texts
content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: reading profiles and stories in print and digital form (e.g. about people, animals), and creating a display with names and short descriptions, for example, Ο ελέφαντας είναι μεγάλος, Το ποντίκι είναι μικρό

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: locating and responding to key information relating to school activities in a Greek context (e.g. from a sister school), and comparing with their own daily schedule/routine, timetable, break time or subjects

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and relaying keywords obtained from short spoken texts with some unfamiliar language, for example, some items on a recorded shopping list (e.g. ένα γάλα, δύο ψωμιά, ένα κιλό μπανάνες, ένα πακέτο παξιμάδια); sequencing pictures/items in order of what they hear

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: surveying/interviewing peers regarding their likes, interests, routines, and activities, and compiling the results in charts, Venn diagrams, graphs, or pictorial presentations, for example, 10 μαθητές έχουν σκυλιά

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to, reading and viewing stories in various formats such as Aesop’s fables or stories by contemporary Greek authors, and responding to questions about characters, themes and events

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using information and descriptive language from a Greek myth or legend, creating a profile or digital presentation about a character, their personality traits, attributes, and their achievements, for example, Θεά Αθηνά, κουκουβάγια, ελιά, σπαθί, ασπίδα, Θεά της σοφίας

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: obtaining information from various sources and deciding which facts to include in a text about the school or community, for example, choosing facts or items that would be useful for Greek-speaking visitors such as a school/neighbourhood map, timetable, or canteen menu

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing images and/or videos about topics being studied and locating relevant information, for example, viewing a beach picture and responding using language such as τα παιδιά κολυμπούν, ο γλάρος πετάει, or looking at a photo or other image and using it to complete a ‘Word, phrase, sentence’ activity (where students say or write a word, then a phrase and finally a sentence that describes the image they have viewed)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a timeline or sequence of the main events of a story using pictures, words, and simple sentences, for example, a simple bilingual timeline of Greek history with key dates or a storyboard of the main events in a book

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing print or digital advertisements, and locating or responding to key information, for example, viewing an ice cream advertisement and responding with language such as Μου αρέσει η γεύση σοκολάτας

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E11 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: watching or listening to a short weather report, deciding which day to invite their friend to play outside and creating a short invitation or message with corresponding images, for example, Θα κάνει ζέστη το Σάββατο, Πάμε στη θάλασσα

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4C04 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: develop strategies to comprehend and produce Greek, adjusting language to convey meaning and/or intercultural understanding in familiar contexts
content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: playing translation games at word or sentence level, for example, matching activities, collaborative translation, verbal dominoes

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: translating simple sentences from Greek into English and vice versa, noticing how meaning can change when translating, as in the case of expressions of politeness (e.g. Ένα μολύβι παρακαλώ), or how a literal translation of Μπορώ να έχω ένα μολύβι σε παρακαλώ; would not be used in Greek

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: translating signs or phrases in familiar contexts from Greek into English such as street signs, addresses or food labels (e.g. Δελφών 30, ΟΔΟΣ ΕΡΜΟΥ, ΦΡΕΣΚΟ ΓΑΛΑ, 4€), noting that some signs and symbols are universal, for example, the ‘stop’ sign is a similar shape and colour in many countries

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating handmade or digital greeting cards in both Greek and English for different celebrations and traditions, and adjusting language accordingly, for example, Καλά Χριστούγεννα, Καλό Πάσχα, φιλάκια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating resources for the class to reinforce learning and exposure to language concepts, for example, pattern charts; a bilingual class digital dictionary; a vocabulary mind map with connected words; a board game

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: learning that Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander languages change according to connections and relationships between people and giving examples of how this occurs in Greek, for example, showing respect when addressing elders by saying Τι κάνετε; instead of Τι κάνεις;

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAP2
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have sophisticated political, economic and social organisation systems, which include but are not limited to family and kinship structures, laws, traditions, customs, land tenure systems and protocols for strong governance and authority.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying some Greek morphemes – prefixes, roots or suffixes – to build vocabulary and predict meaning of unfamiliar language, for example, anti- as in anticlockwise, -logy as in technology, -phone as in telephone

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4U03 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: recognise and compare familiar Greek language structures and features with those of English and/or other languages, using simple metalanguage

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing Greek, English and/or other language names, for example, discussing how female names often end with a vowel or vowel sound (e.g. Μαρία, Αγγελική) and male names often end with ς (e.g. Χρήστος, Δημήτρης, Κώστας)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing vocabulary to describe and explain features of Greek using metalanguage, for example, using the terms ‘masculine’, ‘feminine’, ‘neuter’, ‘nouns’, ‘verbs’, ‘tenses’, ‘adjectives’, ‘conjunctions’, in Greek/English and/or other languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing how Australian English terms and expressions might be understood or interpreted from a Greek perspective, for example, ‘the outback’, ‘bushwalking’, ‘kick a footy’ or ‘no worries’

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying the main linguistic features of texts (e.g. narrative, song, rhyme or poem; simple description, dialogue or procedure such as a recipe) in Greek, English and/or other languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing the differences between texts of the same mode/macro skill, for example, a birthday card and an email, and between multimodal texts, for example, listening to or reading the lyrics of a song; reading a dialogue and acting it out

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising how different textual elements combine to make meaning, for example, how the images, font, script and layout of different texts combine to create a whole advertisement, webpage or picture book

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing that languages are fluid, ever-evolving and influence each other, for example, some words in Greek, such as πάρτι, χόμπι, μπάσκετ, κομπιούτερ, are borrowed from other languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that Ancient Greek has developed into Modern Greek, and that this has influenced many languages, including some words in English, for example, aeroplane, astronaut, history, mathematics, Nike, school, story

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising similarities and differences in word order in sentences written in simple Greek, English and/or other languages, for example, subject+verb+object Εγώ μελετώ ελληνικά (I study Greek), compared with object+verb+subject Ελληνικά μελετώ εγώ (Greek [is what] I study)

as_extracts.name: LMGF104-E04
as_extracts.description: They use modelled language and basic grammatical structures to create texts.

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4C01 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: initiate exchanges and respond to modelled questions about themselves, others and the classroom environment, using formulaic expressions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: selecting formal/informal greetings for real or simulated situations, depending on the time of day and relationship to the other person, for example, Καλημέρα φίλε, Καλησπέρα κύριε Χρήστο or Καληνύχτα μαμά, and using first names when greeting friends, but adding a salutation when addressing adults, for example, Γεια σας κυρία Βάσω, Τι κάνετε κύριε Δημήτρη;

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: initiating conversations using modelled words, phrases or spontaneous interjections, for example, Α καλά, έτσι μπράβο, έλα, Πω πω!, Ωραία!, Όπα!

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: describing features, characteristics and locations of things or places, for example, Πού είναι η κόλλα; Βρίσκεται στο γραφείο του δασκάλου

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: asking for permission and requesting help using formulaic phrases (e.g. θέλω βοήθεια, ελάτε κυρία, δεν καταλαβαίνω), or asking how to say or write a word or expression (e.g. Πώς το λένε)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: requesting information from others using modelled sentences, for example, Πού είναι ο κύριος Βασίλης; Να τος., Πού είναι η δασκάλα;, Τι ώρα είναι; Είναι μία η ώρα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in class surveys and graphing activities about family members, and asking and responding to questions such as Πόσα αδέρφια έχεις; Έχω δύο αδερφές

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: exchanging simple correspondence with peers, such as notes, invitations or birthday cards in print or digital form

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: playing speaking games (e.g. I spy and What am I?) using formulaic opening statements such as Βλέπω κάτι που αρχίζει με κάπα, Έχω τέσσερα πόδια, μία ουρά …, and responses such as κόλλα, καρέκλα, είσαι γάτα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: responding to questions about daily and classroom routines, for example, Πού είναι το φως;, Nα το., Πού είναι ο Τάκης; Nα τος., Πού είναι η Άννα; Nα τη., Τι μέρα είναι σήμερα; Σήμερα είναι Δευτέρα., Τι καιρό κάνει σήμερα; Κάνει κρύο / Bρέχει /, Δε βρέχει /, Ούτε κρύο, ούτε ζέστη

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4C02 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: participate in activities that involve expressing interests and exchanging information, using a range of familiar phrases and modelled structures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using appropriate body language and gestures in response to enquiries, for example, ναι, μ’αρέσει, δε μ’αρέσει, understanding that lifting the head means ‘no’ and is used only in informal situations

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: planning, rehearsing and performing an item for an audience such as school assembly, another class or parents, and delegating roles and responsibilities

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: following simple procedures and using familiar phrases and modelled structures for shared activities, for example, following a recipe and naming ingredients to make κουλουράκια, λουκουμάδες, τηγανίτες or φρουτοσαλάτα, following instructions in a craft activity to make a kite for Καθαρή Δευτέρα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in a role-play or skit (e.g. buying goods from an ελληνική αγορά), using props (e.g. Καραγκιόζη or Τάκη the bear) to engage in conversation, for example, Πόσο κάνει το γάλα; Δύο δολλάρια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: engaging in group games such as snap, Simon says, memory, matching cards, or a ball game, praising and encouraging peers, and taking turns, for example, μπράβο σου, ωραία, προσπάθησε, έλα, σειρά μου, σειρά σου

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: taking turns in pairs to assist the teacher with classroom tasks and responsibilities, for example, roll call, distributing/collecting work, giving basic instructions such as Λείπει ο Γιάννης, Είναι άρρωστος, ορίστε, γράψτε and διαβάστε

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: engaging in shared reading activities where students access information from the text to help them make meaning, identifying relevant language features, discussing unfamiliar vocabulary, and thinking critically about the text, for example, ‘Fact or opinion?’, where they read statements about the text and decide whether it is a fact or an opinion

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: collaborating with peers to plan for and complete tasks such as designing a poster or invitation for a significant event (e.g. 25η Μαρτίου, Aπόκριες) or a class party, and deciding what items to bring, for example, Θα φέρω γλυκό, θα φέρω σαλάτα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: performing simple stories or known fairytales in reader’s theatre activities, demonstrating expression when reading their part

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in cooking or craft activities and using modelled structures to sequence information or write simple procedural texts, for example, recipes or instructions where familiar phrases are used such as ανακάτεψε το αλεύρι με τη ζάχαρη, δίπλωσε το χαρτί στη μέση

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4C05 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: create and present spoken and written texts using formulaic expressions, simple phrases and sentences, and modelled textual conventions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: learning songs related to topics being studied, for example, celebrations such as Christmas and singing Christmas carols in front of an audience (e.g. other classes, parents, grandparents)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: completing cut up or jumbled sentence activities where students move word cards around and manipulate the words to create sentences in proper order

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating spoken, written, print or digital texts using formulaic expressions, simple phrases and sentences to describe family, peers, friends, objects or their favourite pets/animals, for example, Να ο Τάσος, Είναι δέκα χρονών, Του αρέσει να παίζει τένις, Είναι από την Ελλάδα, Μένει στην Αδελαΐδα, Το σπίτι μου, Να η κουζίνα, Να το μπάνιο, Να το αρνάκι, Είναι μικρό

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E04 - Modern Greek

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating handmade or digital greeting cards in both Greek and English for different celebrations and traditions, and adjusting language accordingly, for example, Καλά Χριστούγεννα, Καλό Πάσχα, φιλάκια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating resources for the class to reinforce learning and exposure to language concepts, for example, pattern charts; a bilingual class digital dictionary; a vocabulary mind map with connected words; a board game

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: learning that Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander languages change according to connections and relationships between people and giving examples of how this occurs in Greek, for example, showing respect when addressing elders by saying Τι κάνετε; instead of Τι κάνεις;

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAP2
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have sophisticated political, economic and social organisation systems, which include but are not limited to family and kinship structures, laws, traditions, customs, land tenure systems and protocols for strong governance and authority.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying some Greek morphemes – prefixes, roots or suffixes – to build vocabulary and predict meaning of unfamiliar language, for example, anti- as in anticlockwise, -logy as in technology, -phone as in telephone

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4U01 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: recognise sound combinations, and use patterns of pronunciation and intonation to form words, phrases and simple sentences

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising and pronouncing the sounds of the Greek alphabet as well as the most common digraphs and letter blends (e.g. ου, αι, ει, οι, μπ, ντ, γγ, γκ, τσ, τζ, αυ, ευ), in games such as bingo, memory or other flashcard or digital interactive games, and using them to form words, for example, μου, είναι, όλοι, μπάνιο, ντομάτα, φεγγάρι, γκρι, τσάι, μαϊμού, μελιτζάνα, αύριο, αφτί, Παρασκευή, ευχή

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: practising the reading and writing of letter clusters in short texts, for example, στρ, μπρ, μπλ, γκρ, σπρ in common words or in names; στρώμα, Στράτος, ομπρέλα, μπράβο, μπλε, γκρι, άσπρο in activities such as ‘Read and find’

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: racing each other to find letter clusters as the teacher calls them out

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: focusing on letters and sounds that are different and initially difficult, and pronouncing words starting with the sounds Ψψ and Ξξ - ψάρι, ξύλο, recognising that these 2 sounds only appear in the middle or at the end of words in English, as in axe, six, socks, chips, and are formed with 2 phonemes, ps or ks

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying sounds within high-frequency words when reading, for example, το, και, ναι, μου, έχω, είμαι, είναι, θέλω, να

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using different strategies such as mnemonic devices to remember new sounds, pronunciation and intonation patterns

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding how gestures and intonation are used to modify intended meaning, for example, Είσαι καλά; Τι κάνεις;

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to and repeating basic tongue twisters or plays on words, for example, Μια πάπια μα ποια πάπια; Μια πάπια με παπιά., Σου’πα να φας σούπα, Σήκω να φας σύκο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recording themselves reading short texts aloud to practise sounds, stress and intonation, and predicting pronunciation by sounding out words based on phonetic knowledge

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4U03 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: recognise and compare familiar Greek language structures and features with those of English and/or other languages, using simple metalanguage

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing Greek, English and/or other language names, for example, discussing how female names often end with a vowel or vowel sound (e.g. Μαρία, Αγγελική) and male names often end with ς (e.g. Χρήστος, Δημήτρης, Κώστας)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing vocabulary to describe and explain features of Greek using metalanguage, for example, using the terms ‘masculine’, ‘feminine’, ‘neuter’, ‘nouns’, ‘verbs’, ‘tenses’, ‘adjectives’, ‘conjunctions’, in Greek/English and/or other languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing how Australian English terms and expressions might be understood or interpreted from a Greek perspective, for example, ‘the outback’, ‘bushwalking’, ‘kick a footy’ or ‘no worries’

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying the main linguistic features of texts (e.g. narrative, song, rhyme or poem; simple description, dialogue or procedure such as a recipe) in Greek, English and/or other languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing the differences between texts of the same mode/macro skill, for example, a birthday card and an email, and between multimodal texts, for example, listening to or reading the lyrics of a song; reading a dialogue and acting it out

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising how different textual elements combine to make meaning, for example, how the images, font, script and layout of different texts combine to create a whole advertisement, webpage or picture book

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing that languages are fluid, ever-evolving and influence each other, for example, some words in Greek, such as πάρτι, χόμπι, μπάσκετ, κομπιούτερ, are borrowed from other languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that Ancient Greek has developed into Modern Greek, and that this has influenced many languages, including some words in English, for example, aeroplane, astronaut, history, mathematics, Nike, school, story

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising similarities and differences in word order in sentences written in simple Greek, English and/or other languages, for example, subject+verb+object Εγώ μελετώ ελληνικά (I study Greek), compared with object+verb+subject Ελληνικά μελετώ εγώ (Greek [is what] I study)

as_extracts.name: LMGF104-E08
as_extracts.description: They understand how aspects of language and culture contribute to their own and others’ identity.

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4U04 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: identify connections between personal identity, language and aspects of culture
content_descriptions.sub_strand: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U04-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing a map that shows Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander languages, noticing how many languages are represented in Victoria, and then learning about the diversity of languages that students in the classroom have a connection to

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPACP1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities of Australia maintain a deep connection to, and responsibility for, Country and Place and have holistic values and belief systems that are connected to the land, sea, sky and waterways.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAP1
organising_ideas.text: Australia has 2 distinct First Nations Peoples; each encompasses a diversity of nations across Australia. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have occupied the Australian continent and adjacent islands from time immemorial.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U04-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring the meaning of culture and identity, for example, creating a multimedia presentation to show ways of celebrating, dress, traditions, symbols, manners, routines and behaviours, languages spoken, preferences and values

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U04-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing ways of communicating appropriately in Greek and non-Greek contexts, for example, polite and impolite ways of indicating ‘yes’ or ‘no’ to an adult; the acceptable practice of using teachers’ first names (e.g. κυρία Άννα, κύριε Δημήτρη) and recognising the differences between formal and informal language in social interactions (e.g. Γεια σου φίλε, Γεια σας κύριε); how Greek-speaking people use body language when communicating, which varies according to relationships and context

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U04-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: becoming aware of the variety of ways in which people can be addressed, including the use of non-gendered expressions such as Καλημέρα τάξη

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U04-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a ‘language portrait’ of themselves by using a whole-body silhouette, where students represent their personal experiences of language and culture by adding colours, shapes and words within and around the outline

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U04-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing representations of information used in cultural expressions of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples and making connections with those of Greek language and culture, for example, identifying different regional words used by Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples to identify themselves, such as Zenadth Kes, Koori, Koorie, Noongar and Nunga, and finding out whether similar identification occurs in Greek-speaking cultural groups

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAC1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander societies are diverse and have distinct cultural expressions, such as language, customs and beliefs. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have the right to maintain, control, protect and develop their cultural expressions, while also maintaining the right to control, protect and develop culture as Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U04-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining culturally appropriate phrases for different times of the day and for different purposes, for example, καλή εβδομάδα, καλό μήνα, καλό καλοκαίρι, καλό απόγευμα, καλό μεσημέρι, χρόνια πολλά, καλές γιορτές, καλή όρεξη, and considering their context and use

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U04-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying the Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander Country or Place on which students live and incorporating this into their self-introduction in Greek

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U04-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding that there is the standard language called ‘Modern Greek’, as well as several different language variations spoken throughout Greece, Cyprus and the Greek diaspora, which reflect the cultural diversity of Greek-speaking communities

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U04-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising and explaining to others the significance of familiar Greek cultural practices maintained over time (e.g. festivals, birthdays and name days; the importance of hospitality; το κέρασμα στη γιορτή; πανηγύρια; singing the national anthem), and reflecting on authentic Greek cultural elements and traditions (e.g. sugared almonds at weddings and baptisms, βασιλόπιτα, τσουρέκι) and the associated symbolism and language

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4C01 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: initiate exchanges and respond to modelled questions about themselves, others and the classroom environment, using formulaic expressions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: selecting formal/informal greetings for real or simulated situations, depending on the time of day and relationship to the other person, for example, Καλημέρα φίλε, Καλησπέρα κύριε Χρήστο or Καληνύχτα μαμά, and using first names when greeting friends, but adding a salutation when addressing adults, for example, Γεια σας κυρία Βάσω, Τι κάνετε κύριε Δημήτρη;

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: initiating conversations using modelled words, phrases or spontaneous interjections, for example, Α καλά, έτσι μπράβο, έλα, Πω πω!, Ωραία!, Όπα!

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: describing features, characteristics and locations of things or places, for example, Πού είναι η κόλλα; Βρίσκεται στο γραφείο του δασκάλου

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: asking for permission and requesting help using formulaic phrases (e.g. θέλω βοήθεια, ελάτε κυρία, δεν καταλαβαίνω), or asking how to say or write a word or expression (e.g. Πώς το λένε)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: requesting information from others using modelled sentences, for example, Πού είναι ο κύριος Βασίλης; Να τος., Πού είναι η δασκάλα;, Τι ώρα είναι; Είναι μία η ώρα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in class surveys and graphing activities about family members, and asking and responding to questions such as Πόσα αδέρφια έχεις; Έχω δύο αδερφές

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: exchanging simple correspondence with peers, such as notes, invitations or birthday cards in print or digital form

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: playing speaking games (e.g. I spy and What am I?) using formulaic opening statements such as Βλέπω κάτι που αρχίζει με κάπα, Έχω τέσσερα πόδια, μία ουρά …, and responses such as κόλλα, καρέκλα, είσαι γάτα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C01-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: responding to questions about daily and classroom routines, for example, Πού είναι το φως;, Nα το., Πού είναι ο Τάκης; Nα τος., Πού είναι η Άννα; Nα τη., Τι μέρα είναι σήμερα; Σήμερα είναι Δευτέρα., Τι καιρό κάνει σήμερα; Κάνει κρύο / Bρέχει /, Δε βρέχει /, Ούτε κρύο, ούτε ζέστη

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4C02 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: participate in activities that involve expressing interests and exchanging information, using a range of familiar phrases and modelled structures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using appropriate body language and gestures in response to enquiries, for example, ναι, μ’αρέσει, δε μ’αρέσει, understanding that lifting the head means ‘no’ and is used only in informal situations

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: planning, rehearsing and performing an item for an audience such as school assembly, another class or parents, and delegating roles and responsibilities

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: following simple procedures and using familiar phrases and modelled structures for shared activities, for example, following a recipe and naming ingredients to make κουλουράκια, λουκουμάδες, τηγανίτες or φρουτοσαλάτα, following instructions in a craft activity to make a kite for Καθαρή Δευτέρα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in a role-play or skit (e.g. buying goods from an ελληνική αγορά), using props (e.g. Καραγκιόζη or Τάκη the bear) to engage in conversation, for example, Πόσο κάνει το γάλα; Δύο δολλάρια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: engaging in group games such as snap, Simon says, memory, matching cards, or a ball game, praising and encouraging peers, and taking turns, for example, μπράβο σου, ωραία, προσπάθησε, έλα, σειρά μου, σειρά σου

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: taking turns in pairs to assist the teacher with classroom tasks and responsibilities, for example, roll call, distributing/collecting work, giving basic instructions such as Λείπει ο Γιάννης, Είναι άρρωστος, ορίστε, γράψτε and διαβάστε

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: engaging in shared reading activities where students access information from the text to help them make meaning, identifying relevant language features, discussing unfamiliar vocabulary, and thinking critically about the text, for example, ‘Fact or opinion?’, where they read statements about the text and decide whether it is a fact or an opinion

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: collaborating with peers to plan for and complete tasks such as designing a poster or invitation for a significant event (e.g. 25η Μαρτίου, Aπόκριες) or a class party, and deciding what items to bring, for example, Θα φέρω γλυκό, θα φέρω σαλάτα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: performing simple stories or known fairytales in reader’s theatre activities, demonstrating expression when reading their part

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C02-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in cooking or craft activities and using modelled structures to sequence information or write simple procedural texts, for example, recipes or instructions where familiar phrases are used such as ανακάτεψε το αλεύρι με τη ζάχαρη, δίπλωσε το χαρτί στη μέση

strand_substrands.substrand_title: Mediating meaning in and between languages
strand_substrands.substrand_tag: Mediating meaning in and between languages

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4C03 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: locate and respond to key information related to familiar content obtained from spoken, written, viewed and multimodal texts
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: reading profiles and stories in print and digital form (e.g. about people, animals), and creating a display with names and short descriptions, for example, Ο ελέφαντας είναι μεγάλος, Το ποντίκι είναι μικρό

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: locating and responding to key information relating to school activities in a Greek context (e.g. from a sister school), and comparing with their own daily schedule/routine, timetable, break time or subjects

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and relaying keywords obtained from short spoken texts with some unfamiliar language, for example, some items on a recorded shopping list (e.g. ένα γάλα, δύο ψωμιά, ένα κιλό μπανάνες, ένα πακέτο παξιμάδια); sequencing pictures/items in order of what they hear

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: surveying/interviewing peers regarding their likes, interests, routines, and activities, and compiling the results in charts, Venn diagrams, graphs, or pictorial presentations, for example, 10 μαθητές έχουν σκυλιά

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to, reading and viewing stories in various formats such as Aesop’s fables or stories by contemporary Greek authors, and responding to questions about characters, themes and events

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using information and descriptive language from a Greek myth or legend, creating a profile or digital presentation about a character, their personality traits, attributes, and their achievements, for example, Θεά Αθηνά, κουκουβάγια, ελιά, σπαθί, ασπίδα, Θεά της σοφίας

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: obtaining information from various sources and deciding which facts to include in a text about the school or community, for example, choosing facts or items that would be useful for Greek-speaking visitors such as a school/neighbourhood map, timetable, or canteen menu

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing images and/or videos about topics being studied and locating relevant information, for example, viewing a beach picture and responding using language such as τα παιδιά κολυμπούν, ο γλάρος πετάει, or looking at a photo or other image and using it to complete a ‘Word, phrase, sentence’ activity (where students say or write a word, then a phrase and finally a sentence that describes the image they have viewed)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a timeline or sequence of the main events of a story using pictures, words, and simple sentences, for example, a simple bilingual timeline of Greek history with key dates or a storyboard of the main events in a book

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing print or digital advertisements, and locating or responding to key information, for example, viewing an ice cream advertisement and responding with language such as Μου αρέσει η γεύση σοκολάτας

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C03-E11 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: watching or listening to a short weather report, deciding which day to invite their friend to play outside and creating a short invitation or message with corresponding images, for example, Θα κάνει ζέστη το Σάββατο, Πάμε στη θάλασσα

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4C04 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: develop strategies to comprehend and produce Greek, adjusting language to convey meaning and/or intercultural understanding in familiar contexts
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: playing translation games at word or sentence level, for example, matching activities, collaborative translation, verbal dominoes

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: translating simple sentences from Greek into English and vice versa, noticing how meaning can change when translating, as in the case of expressions of politeness (e.g. Ένα μολύβι παρακαλώ), or how a literal translation of Μπορώ να έχω ένα μολύβι σε παρακαλώ; would not be used in Greek

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: translating signs or phrases in familiar contexts from Greek into English such as street signs, addresses or food labels (e.g. Δελφών 30, ΟΔΟΣ ΕΡΜΟΥ, ΦΡΕΣΚΟ ΓΑΛΑ, 4€), noting that some signs and symbols are universal, for example, the ‘stop’ sign is a similar shape and colour in many countries

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating handmade or digital greeting cards in both Greek and English for different celebrations and traditions, and adjusting language accordingly, for example, Καλά Χριστούγεννα, Καλό Πάσχα, φιλάκια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating resources for the class to reinforce learning and exposure to language concepts, for example, pattern charts; a bilingual class digital dictionary; a vocabulary mind map with connected words; a board game

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: learning that Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander languages change according to connections and relationships between people and giving examples of how this occurs in Greek, for example, showing respect when addressing elders by saying Τι κάνετε; instead of Τι κάνεις;

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAP2
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have sophisticated political, economic and social organisation systems, which include but are not limited to family and kinship structures, laws, traditions, customs, land tenure systems and protocols for strong governance and authority.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C04-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying some Greek morphemes – prefixes, roots or suffixes – to build vocabulary and predict meaning of unfamiliar language, for example, anti- as in anticlockwise, -logy as in technology, -phone as in telephone

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4C05 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: create and present spoken and written texts using formulaic expressions, simple phrases and sentences, and modelled textual conventions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: learning songs related to topics being studied, for example, celebrations such as Christmas and singing Christmas carols in front of an audience (e.g. other classes, parents, grandparents)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: completing cut up or jumbled sentence activities where students move word cards around and manipulate the words to create sentences in proper order

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating spoken, written, print or digital texts using formulaic expressions, simple phrases and sentences to describe family, peers, friends, objects or their favourite pets/animals, for example, Να ο Τάσος, Είναι δέκα χρονών, Του αρέσει να παίζει τένις, Είναι από την Ελλάδα, Μένει στην Αδελαΐδα, Το σπίτι μου, Να η κουζίνα, Να το μπάνιο, Να το αρνάκι, Είναι μικρό

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a class profile using information collected from peers (e.g. creating a chart or database to identify favourite sports, food or colours), for example, το μπάσκετ, το ποδόσφαιρο, το παστίτσιο, η κοτόσουπα, άσπρο, κόκκινο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating and exchanging simple correspondence such as bilingual greeting cards, notes, invitations or messages, in print or digital form

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating simple descriptions in Greek and matching them to appropriate Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Country or Place in their local area or elsewhere in Australia

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPACP1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities of Australia maintain a deep connection to, and responsibility for, Country and Place and have holistic values and belief systems that are connected to the land, sea, sky and waterways.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: presenting information on events or topics of possible interest to children of their own age in Greek-speaking communities, using multimodal resources and authentic materials such as menus, recipes, invitations, instructions, artefacts, brochures or maps

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating and performing simple imaginative texts, switching between Greek and English to enhance meaning, and using dance, singing, movement or drama to animate characters and to give expression to events in texts, for example, acting out scenes from a story; adopting the profile of a character such as Theseus, the Minotaur, Icarus, Hercules, Cyclops or Persephone

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: modifying texts with their own creative input, for example, substituting words or characters (e.g. with an animal, Greek food) in a well-known song, story or procedure, such as «Η Mικρή Ελένη», «Χρόνια πολλά», Η πολύ πεινασμένη κάμπια, or modifying a recipe with alternative ingredients

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4C05-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using scaffolded textual conventions by creating a new story, for example, in the form of a digital picture book; using favourite characters from imaginative texts such as Ηρακλής or Σποτ, and adding captions using formulaic expressions and modelled language such as Μια φορά και έναν καιρό, Τέλος, Και ζήσαν αυτοί καλά κι εμείς καλύτερα

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4U01 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: recognise sound combinations, and use patterns of pronunciation and intonation to form words, phrases and simple sentences

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising and pronouncing the sounds of the Greek alphabet as well as the most common digraphs and letter blends (e.g. ου, αι, ει, οι, μπ, ντ, γγ, γκ, τσ, τζ, αυ, ευ), in games such as bingo, memory or other flashcard or digital interactive games, and using them to form words, for example, μου, είναι, όλοι, μπάνιο, ντομάτα, φεγγάρι, γκρι, τσάι, μαϊμού, μελιτζάνα, αύριο, αφτί, Παρασκευή, ευχή

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: practising the reading and writing of letter clusters in short texts, for example, στρ, μπρ, μπλ, γκρ, σπρ in common words or in names; στρώμα, Στράτος, ομπρέλα, μπράβο, μπλε, γκρι, άσπρο in activities such as ‘Read and find’

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: racing each other to find letter clusters as the teacher calls them out

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: focusing on letters and sounds that are different and initially difficult, and pronouncing words starting with the sounds Ψψ and Ξξ - ψάρι, ξύλο, recognising that these 2 sounds only appear in the middle or at the end of words in English, as in axe, six, socks, chips, and are formed with 2 phonemes, ps or ks

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying sounds within high-frequency words when reading, for example, το, και, ναι, μου, έχω, είμαι, είναι, θέλω, να

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using different strategies such as mnemonic devices to remember new sounds, pronunciation and intonation patterns

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding how gestures and intonation are used to modify intended meaning, for example, Είσαι καλά; Τι κάνεις;

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to and repeating basic tongue twisters or plays on words, for example, Μια πάπια μα ποια πάπια; Μια πάπια με παπιά., Σου’πα να φας σούπα, Σήκω να φας σύκο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U01-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recording themselves reading short texts aloud to practise sounds, stress and intonation, and predicting pronunciation by sounding out words based on phonetic knowledge

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4U02 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: recognise and use modelled language, formulaic phrases, simple grammatical structures and language conventions to convey meaning

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying appropriate punctuation marks such as full stops, commas, exclamation marks and question marks, when reading and/or writing a range of texts, and using the accent mark appropriately in Greek when reading or writing, for pronunciation as well as meaning

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying nouns (e.g. highlighting nouns in sentences or reading texts), and recognising singular and plural noun endings in shared reading and writing activities, for example, o σκύλος, οι σκύλοι, η γάτα, οι γάτες, το σπίτι, τα σπίτια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying whether given nouns are singular or plural by sorting singular and plural words into piles or writing nouns from a text into the correct columns, and then changing given nouns to singular or plural

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing the use of gender in Greek nouns, singular/plural and articles (e.g. ο μπαμπάς, η Άννα, η γάτα, οι γάτες, το νερό, τα ψάρια) when reading and/or using them in grammar activities (e.g. noun, verb or adjective hunt), changing the noun to plural form, changing nouns to plural in sentences and modifying the verb as needed, for example, το πουλί πετάει-τα πουλιά πετούν

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and categorising nouns as masculine, feminine or neuter during shared reading of a text, for example, Ο μπαμπάς διαβάζει το βιβλίο- ο μπαμπάς (masculine), Η θεία πήγε ταξίδι στην Αφρική - η Αφρική (feminine), το βιβλίο (neuter)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding and using adjectives to describe characteristics or qualities of a person, place or object, for example, τρία μικρά γουρουνάκια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that adjective endings determine the gender and must agree with the noun (e.g. καλός καφές, καλή μαμά, καλό παιδάκι, ψηλός άντρας, ψηλή κοπέλα, ψηλό δέντρο, άσπρος πίνακας), in activities such as ‘spot the mistake’ grammar exercises, silly sentence and build-a-sentence tasks

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using modelled language and formulaic phrases when participating in oral practice exercises, such as timed pair practice, sentence starters and finish the sentence

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating simple sentences in the subject+verb+object order, for example, Το βάζο έχει λουλούδια, To όνομά μου είναι …

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using familiar verbs in sentences, for example, η γάτα τρέχει, το παιδί τρώει, η μαμά γελά, έλα μπαμπά, ελάτε μέσα, άνοιξε την πόρτα, έχω στυλό

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E11 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: experimenting with compound sentences using conjunctions such as και and αλλά, during sentence-writing activities where students combine 2 simple sentences

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E12 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using some adverbs of place, degree and certainty (e.g. έξω, μέσα, πάνω, κάτω, μπροστά, πίσω, δίπλα, γύρω, λίγο, πολύ, ναι, μάλιστα, όχι, δε(ν), μη(ν)) and some modelled use of adverbs of time (e.g. σήμερα, αύριο, χτες) in activities such as sentence building, or writing instructions, procedures or directions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E13 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding that some words can mean different things in different contexts, for example, μπάνιο can mean ‘bathroom’, ‘bathtub’ or ‘swimming at the beach’

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E14 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: expressing negation in simple sentences, for example, Όχι, δεν το θέλω, δε μ’ αρέσει, κάνει κρύο/δεν κάνει κρύο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U02-E15 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: expanding counting ability to larger numbers, in context and with support, such as έχω εκατό δολλάρια, and using numbers to tell the time, for example, Είναι μία η ώρα

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG4U03 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: recognise and compare familiar Greek language structures and features with those of English and/or other languages, using simple metalanguage

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing Greek, English and/or other language names, for example, discussing how female names often end with a vowel or vowel sound (e.g. Μαρία, Αγγελική) and male names often end with ς (e.g. Χρήστος, Δημήτρης, Κώστας)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing vocabulary to describe and explain features of Greek using metalanguage, for example, using the terms ‘masculine’, ‘feminine’, ‘neuter’, ‘nouns’, ‘verbs’, ‘tenses’, ‘adjectives’, ‘conjunctions’, in Greek/English and/or other languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing how Australian English terms and expressions might be understood or interpreted from a Greek perspective, for example, ‘the outback’, ‘bushwalking’, ‘kick a footy’ or ‘no worries’

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying the main linguistic features of texts (e.g. narrative, song, rhyme or poem; simple description, dialogue or procedure such as a recipe) in Greek, English and/or other languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing the differences between texts of the same mode/macro skill, for example, a birthday card and an email, and between multimodal texts, for example, listening to or reading the lyrics of a song; reading a dialogue and acting it out

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising how different textual elements combine to make meaning, for example, how the images, font, script and layout of different texts combine to create a whole advertisement, webpage or picture book

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing that languages are fluid, ever-evolving and influence each other, for example, some words in Greek, such as πάρτι, χόμπι, μπάσκετ, κομπιούτερ, are borrowed from other languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising that Ancient Greek has developed into Modern Greek, and that this has influenced many languages, including some words in English, for example, aeroplane, astronaut, history, mathematics, Nike, school, story

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U03-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising similarities and differences in word order in sentences written in simple Greek, English and/or other languages, for example, subject+verb+object Εγώ μελετώ ελληνικά (I study Greek), compared with object+verb+subject Ελληνικά μελετώ εγώ (Greek [is what] I study)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG4U04-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: viewing a map that shows Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander languages, noticing how many languages are represented in Victoria, and then learning about the diversity of languages that students in the classroom have a connection to
