content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10CM06 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: create and present spoken and written texts, selecting vocabulary, expressions, grammatical structures and textual conventions for familiar and some unfamiliar contexts and purposes, to engage different audiences

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: working in pairs to write a text message or ‘comment’ on a or secure, teacher-moderated social media platform, experimenting with handles (@) and hashtags (#), for example, Πώς είναι ο καιρός; #ηλιόλουστος, Σώσε τον πλανήτη μας! #ανακύκλωση

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing a recipe and procedure for a fusion dish in Greek with footnotes in English about the ingredients and flavours, for example, ελληνικά τάκος, φέτα Ηπείρου με βετζεμάιτ, πατάτες τηγανιτές με φύκια, λουκουμάδες με μερέντα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: presenting information about cultural events in different formats such as captioned photographs, digital presentation or emails, for example, a digital presentation about the Antipodes festival, traditional dance performances and costumes

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a print or digital advertisement or travel brochure in Greek for travel to an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander Country or Place, including what to see and do, traditional and/or cultural considerations, means of travel, best time of year to visit, what to bring and what to wear

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPACP1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities of Australia maintain a deep connection to, and responsibility for, Country and Place and have holistic values and belief systems that are connected to the land, sea, sky and waterways.

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: illustrating and captioning imaginative stories or characters in different formats such as cartoons or photo stories, using descriptive and expressive language (e.g. Η παρέα μου), or using other devices such as alliteration or similes and metaphors (e.g. άσπρος σαν το χιόνι, κολυμπά σαν δελφίνι, κρύος σαν πάγος)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing and/or narrating a diary entry for an imaginary or real character such as a person living during the period of the Greek Revolution or a Greek philosopher or mathematician, for example, Σήμερα πήραμε πίσω τη Θεσσαλονίκη. Σήμερα ανακάλυψα ότι η γη είναι επίπεδη. Εγώ, ο Πυθαγόρας, έκανα μια νέα ανακάλυψη.

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: presenting digital texts in Greek on topics such as recycling, sustainability and the ‘zero waste’ movement, school life, sports or leisure activities

organising_ideas.name: Sustainability - VC2CCPSIS2
organising_ideas.text: Sustainable patterns of living require the responsible use of resources; circular economies; maintenance of clean air, water and soils; and the restoration of healthy environments and habitats with ecological integrity.
organising_ideas.ccp: Sustainability

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: explaining a Greek custom or practice to an Australian audience, for example, Απόκριες, using appropriate language structures and supporting graphics, materials and gestures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating persuasive texts such as promotional brochures, speech scripts, infographics or video clips to encourage people from the wider community to attend an event or to recycle waste containers and materials, for example, Ανακύκλωσε σήμερα για να έχεις αύριο

organising_ideas.name: Sustainability - VC2CCPSWV2
organising_ideas.text: Worldviews are formed by different experiences at a personal, local, national and global level, and are linked to individual, community and political mandates and actions for sustainability.
organising_ideas.ccp: Sustainability

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a range of texts to entertain and engage specific audiences (e.g. digital books, songs, cartoons, video clips suitable for young or new learners of Greek), or creating a new or modified versions of songs or stories, such as changing the words, introducing a new character or creating an alternate ending

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10UL02 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: apply understanding of context and grammatical structures to respond to and create a range of texts that include some complex structures, ideas and conventions appropriate to formality and text type

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the function of comparative and superlative adjectives, for example, πιο μεγάλος/πιο μεγάλη, μεγαλύτερος/μεγαλύτερη, ο πιο μεγάλος/η πιο μεγάλη

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding that personal pronouns can be omitted in Greek because it is implied through the verb ending, for example, Παίζουν μπάλα. Τραγουδάει ωραία. Διαβάζουμε πολλά βιβλία στις διακοπές

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using cardinal and ordinal numbers such as ένας σκύλος, δύο γάτες, τρεις καμήλες and πρώτος -η-ο, δεύτερος, τρίτος, τέταρτος, for example, when describing results of a sports event

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using prepositions and directions, for example, δεξιά, αριστερά, γύρω από, πίσω από, μπροστά από, ευθεία, when asking and giving directions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: extending understanding and use of present, past and future tenses (e.g. είμαι, ήμουν, θα είμαι, έχω, είχα, θα έχω, έπαιξα, παίζω, θα παίξω, θα παίζω), referring to the past, present and future using adverbs of time, for example, σήμερα, αύριο, χτες, μεθαύριο, προχτές, πριν λίγες μέρες when describing weekly activities

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a wider range of adjectives such as ευαίσθητος-η-ο, δυσαρεστημένος-η-ο and ευχαριστημένος-η-ο, when describing a friend’s qualities

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using possessive pronouns (e.g. μου, σου, του, της, του, μας, σας, τους, δικός μου, δική μου, δικό του), for example, η καρέκλα σας, το παντελόνι της, ο πατέρας τους, το δικό μου σκυλί, η δική μου απόφαση, ο δικός μου δρόμος

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: extending meaning by using adverbs of place, time and manner, such as εδώ, εκεί, κάπου-κάπου, πότε-πότε, εκεί που

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the use of πολύ and πολλή and applying the correct form in texts, for example, πολύ ωραία, πολλή ώρα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using expressions with the verb κάνω, κάνει κρύο/ζέστη, κάνω δουλειές, κάνω όνειρα, Τι κάνεις;

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E11 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using the conjunctions για να, έτσι ώστε, αν και, όμως, όταν to link and sequence ideas and develop compound sentences

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E12 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using prior knowledge of morphemes to predict the meaning and spelling of unfamiliar words, for example, auto-, bio-, demo-, -gram, hypo-, -ism, -logue, mono-, morph-, peri-, phil-, -phobia, psych-, -therm- in words such as ξενοφοβία, ψυχολόγος, περιφέρεια

content_descriptions.text: apply features and conventions of spoken Greek to enhance and extend fluency, and to respond to and create a range of texts in familiar and unfamiliar contexts

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying differences in sounds such as γγ, γκ, τζ, τσ, μπ, ντ, αϊ, άι, -ασμα and using them appropriately when writing, for example, φεγγάρι, γκάζι

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: experimenting with pronunciation rules and intonation collaboratively with peers, for example, αυ, ευ, τσ, τζ, αι, ββ, λλ, ρρ, ττ, ιου, ιο/ιό, ειο/ειου, αυτή, εύκολη, by randomly selecting cards with these digraphs

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising the differences in tone and rhythm between questions, exclamations and commands, for example, Αλήθεια; Σοβαρά, Αμέσως, Ετοιμάσου γρήγορα! Τι λες! and practising raising and lowering their finger to mimic the rhythm

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising and reproducing rhythms in more complex sentences, using pauses, intonation, fillers and interjections to signal emphasis, show interest and keep the conversation flowing, for example, ναι ναι, αλήθεια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: building fluency and accuracy of speech in relation to pitch, stress and rhythm by practising tongue twisters or challenging sentences or by recording themselves speaking Greek and reflecting on this when listening to it played back

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the role of pronunciation, rhythm and pace in creating effects and relationships in spoken texts such as songs, stories, poems and conversations, for example, in the song «Καλημέρα, τι κάνεις»

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: reciting advanced tongue twisters (or making their own) to build vocabulary and improve pronunciation, fluency and pace, for example, Πίτα σπανακόπιτα, σπανακολαδόπιτα. Πίτα σπανακόπιτα, σπανακολαδοφραγκοσυκόπιτα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using prior knowledge of Greek pronunciation to transcribe spoken text, writing down words and sentences as they hear them, predicting spelling of unfamiliar words, for example, μπαούλο, γυμνάσιο, στρουθοκάμηλος

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10UL02 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: apply understanding of context and grammatical structures to respond to and create a range of texts that include some complex structures, ideas and conventions appropriate to formality and text type

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the function of comparative and superlative adjectives, for example, πιο μεγάλος/πιο μεγάλη, μεγαλύτερος/μεγαλύτερη, ο πιο μεγάλος/η πιο μεγάλη

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding that personal pronouns can be omitted in Greek because it is implied through the verb ending, for example, Παίζουν μπάλα. Τραγουδάει ωραία. Διαβάζουμε πολλά βιβλία στις διακοπές

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using cardinal and ordinal numbers such as ένας σκύλος, δύο γάτες, τρεις καμήλες and πρώτος -η-ο, δεύτερος, τρίτος, τέταρτος, for example, when describing results of a sports event

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using prepositions and directions, for example, δεξιά, αριστερά, γύρω από, πίσω από, μπροστά από, ευθεία, when asking and giving directions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: extending understanding and use of present, past and future tenses (e.g. είμαι, ήμουν, θα είμαι, έχω, είχα, θα έχω, έπαιξα, παίζω, θα παίξω, θα παίζω), referring to the past, present and future using adverbs of time, for example, σήμερα, αύριο, χτες, μεθαύριο, προχτές, πριν λίγες μέρες when describing weekly activities

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a wider range of adjectives such as ευαίσθητος-η-ο, δυσαρεστημένος-η-ο and ευχαριστημένος-η-ο, when describing a friend’s qualities

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using possessive pronouns (e.g. μου, σου, του, της, του, μας, σας, τους, δικός μου, δική μου, δικό του), for example, η καρέκλα σας, το παντελόνι της, ο πατέρας τους, το δικό μου σκυλί, η δική μου απόφαση, ο δικός μου δρόμος

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: extending meaning by using adverbs of place, time and manner, such as εδώ, εκεί, κάπου-κάπου, πότε-πότε, εκεί που

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the use of πολύ and πολλή and applying the correct form in texts, for example, πολύ ωραία, πολλή ώρα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using expressions with the verb κάνω, κάνει κρύο/ζέστη, κάνω δουλειές, κάνω όνειρα, Τι κάνεις;

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E11 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using the conjunctions για να, έτσι ώστε, αν και, όμως, όταν to link and sequence ideas and develop compound sentences

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E12 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using prior knowledge of morphemes to predict the meaning and spelling of unfamiliar words, for example, auto-, bio-, demo-, -gram, hypo-, -ism, -logue, mono-, morph-, peri-, phil-, -phobia, psych-, -therm- in words such as ξενοφοβία, ψυχολόγος, περιφέρεια

as_extracts.name: LMG71010-E06
as_extracts.description: Students apply features and conventions of spoken Greek to enhance fluency.

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10CM05 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: apply strategies to interpret and respond to non-verbal, spoken and written interactions and produce texts to convey meaning and intercultural understanding in familiar and unfamiliar contexts
content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining and interpreting idiomatic expressions such as Πέρα βρέχει, including expressions that cannot be translated literally, for example, Tα έκανα θάλασσα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing colloquial language and culturally-specific concepts used in Australia (e.g. ‘no worries’, ‘the bush’, ‘outback’ or ‘waterhole’) and comparing with Greek expressions (e.g. έλα, παιδάκι, μου, καλέ), and discussing what colloquial language represents about culture and identity

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: evaluating information from different sources for relevance, cultural appropriateness and significance, for example, facts from a reliable website versus examples from teacher-curated social media or word-of-mouth; examining culturally-specific terms such as το παλικάρι, η λεβεντιά, το φιλότιμο, το κέφι, developing appropriate explanations and discussing possible equivalent terms in English

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: translating public signs, notices and slogans, comparing each other’s versions and considering reasons for any similarities or differences between translations such as use of different methods or various interpretations, for example, Μην πατάτε το πράσινο for ‘Keep off the grass’

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: being aware of ‘false friends’ and how these may lead to confusion or hinder translation (e.g. κόσμος sounds like ‘cosmos’, which in English is outer space but in Greek this word means ‘world’; λιμάνι pronounced ‘limáni’, sounds like it might mean ‘lemon’, but actually means ‘port’) and keeping a word bank of these for reference

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: adapting a text for a different purpose, keeping the original information or intent, for example, rewording a formal email from the principal to create an informal text message for their friend, summarising the key points, such as Όλοι οι μαθητές πρέπει να φοράνε στολή κατά τη διάρκεια των εξετάσεων versus Απίστευτο, αλλά φοράμε στολή στις εξετάσεις!

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing a journal entry or a contribution for a school newsletter in Greek, reflecting on a visit to an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander Country or Place, and, with permission, referring to cultural knowledge of the site’s significance

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAC1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander societies are diverse and have distinct cultural expressions, such as language, customs and beliefs. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have the right to maintain, control, protect and develop their cultural expressions, while also maintaining the right to control, protect and develop culture as Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10CM06 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: create and present spoken and written texts, selecting vocabulary, expressions, grammatical structures and textual conventions for familiar and some unfamiliar contexts and purposes, to engage different audiences

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: working in pairs to write a text message or ‘comment’ on a or secure, teacher-moderated social media platform, experimenting with handles (@) and hashtags (#), for example, Πώς είναι ο καιρός; #ηλιόλουστος, Σώσε τον πλανήτη μας! #ανακύκλωση

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing a recipe and procedure for a fusion dish in Greek with footnotes in English about the ingredients and flavours, for example, ελληνικά τάκος, φέτα Ηπείρου με βετζεμάιτ, πατάτες τηγανιτές με φύκια, λουκουμάδες με μερέντα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: presenting information about cultural events in different formats such as captioned photographs, digital presentation or emails, for example, a digital presentation about the Antipodes festival, traditional dance performances and costumes

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a print or digital advertisement or travel brochure in Greek for travel to an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander Country or Place, including what to see and do, traditional and/or cultural considerations, means of travel, best time of year to visit, what to bring and what to wear

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPACP1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities of Australia maintain a deep connection to, and responsibility for, Country and Place and have holistic values and belief systems that are connected to the land, sea, sky and waterways.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: illustrating and captioning imaginative stories or characters in different formats such as cartoons or photo stories, using descriptive and expressive language (e.g. Η παρέα μου), or using other devices such as alliteration or similes and metaphors (e.g. άσπρος σαν το χιόνι, κολυμπά σαν δελφίνι, κρύος σαν πάγος)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing and/or narrating a diary entry for an imaginary or real character such as a person living during the period of the Greek Revolution or a Greek philosopher or mathematician, for example, Σήμερα πήραμε πίσω τη Θεσσαλονίκη. Σήμερα ανακάλυψα ότι η γη είναι επίπεδη. Εγώ, ο Πυθαγόρας, έκανα μια νέα ανακάλυψη.

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: presenting digital texts in Greek on topics such as recycling, sustainability and the ‘zero waste’ movement, school life, sports or leisure activities

organising_ideas.name: Sustainability - VC2CCPSIS2
organising_ideas.text: Sustainable patterns of living require the responsible use of resources; circular economies; maintenance of clean air, water and soils; and the restoration of healthy environments and habitats with ecological integrity.
organising_ideas.ccp: Sustainability

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: explaining a Greek custom or practice to an Australian audience, for example, Απόκριες, using appropriate language structures and supporting graphics, materials and gestures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating persuasive texts such as promotional brochures, speech scripts, infographics or video clips to encourage people from the wider community to attend an event or to recycle waste containers and materials, for example, Ανακύκλωσε σήμερα για να έχεις αύριο

organising_ideas.name: Sustainability - VC2CCPSWV2
organising_ideas.text: Worldviews are formed by different experiences at a personal, local, national and global level, and are linked to individual, community and political mandates and actions for sustainability.
organising_ideas.ccp: Sustainability

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using possessive pronouns (e.g. μου, σου, του, της, του, μας, σας, τους, δικός μου, δική μου, δικό του), for example, η καρέκλα σας, το παντελόνι της, ο πατέρας τους, το δικό μου σκυλί, η δική μου απόφαση, ο δικός μου δρόμος

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: extending meaning by using adverbs of place, time and manner, such as εδώ, εκεί, κάπου-κάπου, πότε-πότε, εκεί που

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the use of πολύ and πολλή and applying the correct form in texts, for example, πολύ ωραία, πολλή ώρα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using expressions with the verb κάνω, κάνει κρύο/ζέστη, κάνω δουλειές, κάνω όνειρα, Τι κάνεις;

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E11 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using the conjunctions για να, έτσι ώστε, αν και, όμως, όταν to link and sequence ideas and develop compound sentences

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E12 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using prior knowledge of morphemes to predict the meaning and spelling of unfamiliar words, for example, auto-, bio-, demo-, -gram, hypo-, -ism, -logue, mono-, morph-, peri-, phil-, -phobia, psych-, -therm- in words such as ξενοφοβία, ψυχολόγος, περιφέρεια

as_extracts.name: LMG71010-E08
as_extracts.description: They discuss the structures and features of Greek texts using metalanguage.

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10UL03 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: reflect on and evaluate Greek texts, using metalanguage to discuss language structures and features

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing metalanguage and linguistic awareness to learn and discuss language structures and features in Greek, English and/or other languages, for example, conjugation, syntax, adverb, conjunction

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising how grammatical and vocabulary choices shade meaning and establish register, for example, the use of formal or informal pronouns εσύ, εσείς; the use of forms of address κύριος, κυρία, δεσποινίδα; the use of abbreviations such as π.χ, κτλ, ΣΚ- Σαββατοκύριακο, ΠΣΚ-Παρασκευοσαββατοκύριακο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying knowledge of the interrelationship between context, purpose and audience to identify text type and predict the meaning of unfamiliar vocabulary and expressions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying how grammatical choices, words and images combine in a text to achieve particular intentions and effects, for example, the positioning of the reader through the use of personal pronouns, imperative verb forms and negative indicators, and emotive language and images

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing spoken and written forms of familiar types of texts in Greek and English and language functions such as spoken and written apologies or oral storytelling and written reports, noticing differences in grammatical, expressive and textual features, for example, Συγγνώμη που σε πλήγωσα με τις πράξεις μου versus Συγγνώμη

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing Greek and English versions of familiar texts, commenting on similarities and differences in structure, syntax and cultural elements, for example, the adjective preceding the noun (e.g. νόστιμο φαγητό); omission of subject and preposition (e.g. Πηγαίνω σχολείο, Πάμε Ελλάδα)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: interpreting and explaining textual conventions when using technology and secure social media in Greek

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising how Greek letters, words and morphemes are used globally in existing scientific and mathematical terms, and in the creation of new terms, for example, the universal application of Greek in the fields of mathematics, science and medicine

as_extracts.name: LMG71010-E09
as_extracts.description: They reflect on their own language use and cultural identity, and draw on their experience of learning Greek, to discuss how this influences their ideas and ways of communicating.

content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10UL04 - Modern Greek
content_descriptions.text: reflect on and explain how identity is shaped by language(s), culture(s), beliefs, attitudes and values, and how these affect ways of communicating
content_descriptions.sub_strand: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: interacting with Greek speakers (e.g. students from a sister school, fellow travellers or guests) in secure, teacher-moderated online platforms, reflecting on how language choices might be interpreted by Greek speakers and making adjustments to convey intended meaning, taking care with use of hand gestures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining reactions to different perceptions and expectations around similar and different cultural practices in Greek and Australian contexts (e.g. the concept of personal space; greeting with καλό μήνα on the first day of the month; accepting and refusing offers; gift-giving; being offered food when visiting), or examining Greek cultural stereotypes that can lead to generalisations and misconceptions, for example, assumptions about typical diet; celebrations such as shouting ώπα! and smashing plates

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to and/or reading examples of an Acknowledgement of Country in Greek and creating their own version that names the local Country for a Greek-speaking audience

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing an understanding of contemporary life in diverse Greek-speaking communities, for example, viewing excerpts from Greek films such as The Canary Yellow Bicycle and reflecting on similarities and differences from their own lifestyle, practices and traditions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing elements of Greek language and culture and how they have become part of Australian lifestyles, for example, celebrations such as το Γλέντι, το Πανηγύρι; food such as τζατζίκι, γύρος, ντολμάδες; sayings such as ‘Achilles heel’ (αχίλλειος φτέρνα) and ‘Midas touch’ (το άγγιγμα του Μίδα)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing and discussing the interconnected nature of the linguistic and cultural diversity of Greek-speaking communities, and how this is also relevant to the linguistic and cultural diversity in Australia, including that of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAP1
organising_ideas.text: Australia has 2 distinct First Nations Peoples; each encompasses a diversity of nations across Australia. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have occupied the Australian continent and adjacent islands from time immemorial.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and comparing the function and power of cultural representations such as symbols and stories on identity formation and contribution to a sense of national pride, for example, flags; Greek myths and legends; historical events

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing how sociocultural norms related to gender may be embedded in grammatical structures, and identifying possible strategies to increase inclusivity, for example, using the passive voice (ο νέος νόμος ψηφίστηκε στη Βουλή instead of ο/η βουλευτής ψήφισε τον νέο νόμο στη Βουλή)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring how the Greek language has been influenced by English (e.g. the use of non-Greek words such as τα μπίλια instead of οι λογαριασμοί as an Australian phenomenon) and examining how technology, globalisation, migration and social media have influenced the Greek language, for example, the increased use of English words, σκανάρω, το μπλογκ, σερφάρω, γκουγκλ

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: appreciating that many Greek speakers may be bilingual and use other language variations and/or dialects, and this may form part of their identity, beliefs and values, and examining and explaining variations in language use in different Greek-speaking communities and why the Greek language may vary in some aspects of vocabulary (e.g. κοπέλι sounds like κοπέλα, meaning ‘lady’, but it actually means το παιδί, το αγόρι in Cretan dialect), noting, for example, that isolation due to geographical barriers, such as mountains and the sea, led to the development of regional dialects

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10CM01 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: initiate and sustain interactions in familiar and some unfamiliar contexts to exchange ideas, experiences and opinions about their own and others’ personal worlds

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM01-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: initiating conversations with peers, family and others, using expressions appropriate to context and audience, such as Πώς τα πέρασες το Σαββατοκύριακο; Πάμε για ψώνια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM01-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: sustaining face-to-face or online conversations using a secure, teacher-moderated platform, discussing topics relating to teenage life (e.g. parties, jobs, music, friendship, fashion) through active listening skills, turn-taking, non-verbal reactions (shrugging shoulders, head shaking, etc.) and spoken responses to questions such as Πώς ήταν το πάρτι της Μαρίας; Πού δουλεύεις το Σαββατοκύριακο; Τι μουσική ακούς; Γιατί δε μιλάς με το Γιάννη; Μαλώσατε; Σου αρέσει η μπλούζα μου;

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM01-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a range of language structures and communication strategies, such as repairing, self-correction and using gap fillers, to elicit others’ responses and express their own opinions and experiences, for example, Τι νομίζετε; Πιστεύω ότι …, Μ’ αρέσει πιο πολύ η ελληνική μουσική από …, Συγγνώμη, Μ’ αρέσει περισσότερο η ελληνική μουσική από …, Συμφωνείς;, Ξέρεις, και εμένα μου αρέσει …

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM01-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: expressing hopes and ambitions, and giving reasons for plans, for example, Θέλω να γίνω τενίστας γιατί θαυμάζω τον Στέφανο Τσιτσιπά

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM01-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: experimenting with the use of interjections, exclamations and filler words, such as Βασικά …, Δεν μου λες …, Κοίτα …, Εντάξει …, Λοιπόν …, to maintain flow, fill gaps, and build fluency and authenticity, for example, in a partner role-play where a third person is the observer noting the number of times these are used

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM01-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using descriptive and expressive language to participate in role-plays such as job interviews, conversations giving advice about health-related topics, discussing and expressing opinions about the environment or interviewing a celebrity, and justifying personal positions on these matters

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM01-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: practising how to interact in unfamiliar contexts and what strategies and language to use and when, such as helping a stranger with directions; discussing unfamiliar topics; using appropriate interjections; asking for clarification or repetition; asking to elaborate; for example, Πού θέλετε να πάτε; Πηγαίνετε δεξιά και μετά στρίψτε αριστερά; Δεν καταλαβαίνω; Ωχ! Πω πω! Μπορείτε να το επαναλάβετε; Μπορείτε να το εξηγήσετε αλλιώς

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10CM02 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: use Greek language in exchanges to question, offer ideas and opinions, negotiate, compare and discuss

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM02-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using descriptive and expressive language to exchange views, elicit opinions and offer solutions/alternatives to problems, for example, Πώς μπορούμε να βοηθήσουμε το περιβάλλον; Όλοι μπορούμε να βοηθήσουμε, Νομίζω ότι όλοι πρέπει να κάνουμε κάτι, Μπορούμε να φυτέψουμε δέντρα

organising_ideas.name: Sustainability - VC2CCPSIS2
organising_ideas.text: Sustainable patterns of living require the responsible use of resources; circular economies; maintenance of clean air, water and soils; and the restoration of healthy environments and habitats with ecological integrity.
organising_ideas.ccp: Sustainability

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM02-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: interacting in class routines by requesting, advising and apologising, for example, Συγγνώμη δεν κατάλαβα, Μήπως θέλεις βοήθεια; Συγγνώμη δεν έχω το βιβλίο μου, and clarifying meaning or instructions, for example, Ορίστε, Συγγνώμη; Κοίτα/Κοιτάξτε, Τι είπατε

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM02-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: justifying actions and opinions about topics of interest, for example, the benefits of visiting various places/locations in Greek-speaking communities, Θέλω να πάω στο μουσείο, επειδή θέλω να μάθω για την ιστορία της Ελλάδας. Δε συμφωνώ, αυτό είναι τόσο βαρετό! Προτιμώ να πάω στη θάλασσα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM02-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: debating or discussing current affairs and creating campaigns and slogans, for example, μέσα κοινωνικής δικτύωσης- Εσύ αποφασίζεις, κλιματική αλλαγή-Μια μικρή κίνηση, μια μεγάλη αλλαγή, μετανάστευση-Μια πατρίδα για όλους, διάκριση – Όλοι διαφορετικοί, όλοι ίσοι

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM02-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using appropriate discussion protocols such as active listening, showing interest, acknowledging others’ opinions, and responding to, elaborating on and extending ideas, for example, Μάλιστα, Αλήθεια, Σέβομαι αυτό που λες, Ποια είναι η γνώμη σου για αυτό το θέμα;, Νομίζω ότι …, Πιστεύω ότι …

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM02-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in a mock interview for a part-time job or volunteer work, answering questions and discussing ideas, for example, Θέλω να γίνω εθελοντής/εθελόντρια στην Greenpeace. Είμαι καλή με την τεχνολογία

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM02-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in real or simulated transactions and negotiations such as ordering food, shopping, catching public transport (e.g. Πόσο κάνει το παγωτό; Αυτή η μπλούζα είναι πολλή ακριβή. Θέλω μία πιο φθηνή. Πάμε με το λεωφορείο, γιατί είναι πιο φθηνό από το ταξί), and reflecting on the process, for example, Μου άρεσε το σουβλάκι και θα το πάρω ξανά

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10CM03 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: use spoken and written exchanges to discuss, plan and reflect on activities, events and experiences with peers

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM03-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: contributing to collaborative interactions such as creating a schedule for a visiting school group, setting up a school display or hosting an event, for example, Το πρόγραμμά μας για σήμερα είναι ... Καλημέρα και καλωσορίσατε

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM03-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: planning a performance, event or presentation, making decisions collaboratively and delegating roles and responsibilities such as organising a class party (e.g. Να κάνουμε το πάρτι την Τρίτη; Τι φαγητά θέλουμε; Ποιος/Ποια θα φέρει την τούρτα;) or activities for Harmony or Reconciliation Week (e.g. inviting a guest speaker)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM03-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: planning collaboratively for an event by participating in scenarios related to travelling in Greek-speaking communities such as planning an itinerary (e.g. Τη Δευτέρα θα πάμε στην Ακρόπολη, Την Τρίτη θα είμαστε στο Σούνιο), and reflecting on the process and what they would do differently, for example, Την επόμενη φορά πρέπει να κλείσουμε τα εισιτήρια πιο νωρίς

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM03-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in a discussion or forum to review current school policies or rules, such as those relating to use of technology, uniform, start and finish times, waste management or task deadlines, to propose changes or improvements, for example, Επιτρέπεται να έχουμε το κινητό τηλέφωνο μέσα στην τάξη; Πρέπει να επιτρέπεται το κινητό μέσα στην τάξη, Πρέπει να αλλάξουμε το χρώμα της στολής, Γιατί δεν αρχίζουμε το σχολείο στις 10.00;, Πού πρέπει να πετάμε τα σκουπίδια της ανακύκλωσης;

organising_ideas.name: Sustainability - VC2CCPSIS2
organising_ideas.text: Sustainable patterns of living require the responsible use of resources; circular economies; maintenance of clean air, water and soils; and the restoration of healthy environments and habitats with ecological integrity.
organising_ideas.ccp: Sustainability

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM03-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: making a complaint, formally or informally, about poor-quality service or an unsatisfactory product and suggesting a simple solution, for example, Το φαγητό μου είναι κρύο. Μπορείτε να μου φέρετε ένα άλλο πιάτο. Να μου φέρεις άλλο πιάτο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM03-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: keeping a personal Greek ‘progress journal’ to reflect on the process and experience of learning a language, using target vocabulary and structures, and sharing weekly with the teacher for feedback, for example, Να μάθω για … ήταν δύσκολο αλλά δεν τα παράτησα

strand_substrands.substrand_title: Mediating meaning in and between languages
strand_substrands.substrand_tag: Mediating meaning in and between languages

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10CM04 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: interpret and evaluate information, ideas and perspectives in a range of spoken, written, viewed and multimodal texts and respond appropriately to context, purpose and audience
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM04-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: accessing print, digital and multimodal texts detailing lifestyles in Greek-speaking communities, identifying features of ways of life that reflect modernity or tradition, and discussing reasons for differences, for example, discussing images of family life in the past and present

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM04-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: noticing how local names of streets, places and landmarks can have their origins in the languages of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples, identifying the meanings of these place names, for example, ‘You Yangs’ comes from the Wadawurrung words Wurdi Youang, meaning ‘big hill’, and then discussing the names of Greek landforms that also denote physical characteristics such as Λευκά Όρη meaning ‘white mountains’

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPACP1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities of Australia maintain a deep connection to, and responsibility for, Country and Place and have holistic values and belief systems that are connected to the land, sea, sky and waterways.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM04-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising cultural expressions, phrases and etiquette in a range of contexts (e.g. 1st January and gift-giving, first day of the month/week, name day celebrations) and incorporating in their own interactions (e.g. Και του χρόνου, Καλή εβδομάδα, Καλό μήνα, με γεια τα γυαλιά), by referring to a word bank or class poster

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM04-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying how certain expressions give clues about events and celebrations, for example, Καλό ταξίδι, Στο καλό, Και στα δικά σου, Καλή αντάμωση!

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM04-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring and gathering information on a range of cultural practices and traditions from a variety of sources (e.g. viewing excerpts from a Greek song or video of a festival), annotating and discussing with peers aspects that were interesting and surprising, such as the large number of people of all ages who join the communal dancing

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM04-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: obtaining and compiling perspectives and attitudes regarding social and cultural issues in their own community, for example, interviewing a local environmental group and presenting information/opinions according to audience (e.g. graphs or charts using informal language for peers or more formal language in a report to the general school community; Μπορούμε να βοηθήσουμε το περιβάλλον αν …)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM04-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing stories such as Greek folktales/myths or Aesop’s fables (e.g. Ο βασιλιάς Μίδας, Ο λαγός και η χελώνα), discussing the values/morals portrayed in such stories, and explaining these to younger students or those unfamiliar with such texts

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM04-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to or reading Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander stories in English and creating a profile in Greek, for example, locating protagonists, context, setting and key meaning

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAP3
organising_ideas.text: The significant and ongoing contributions of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples and their histories and cultures are acknowledged locally, nationally and globally.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM04-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: researching a Greek festival, experience, event or tourist site, using guiding questions and facts from texts to plan and write a postcard in the voice of the journeying character, for example, Πού είσαι;, Σου αρέσει;, Γιατί ή γιατί όχι;, Τι σου έχει συμβεί μέχρι τώρα;, Τι σου έκανε εντύπωση;, Τι έχετε μάθει μέχρι τώρα, για τον εαυτό σας ή τους άλλους;, Τι θα κάνεις;, Είμαι στα Γιαννιτσά και περνάω καταπληκτικά! Κάθε μέρα τρώω μπουγάτσα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM04-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing a ‘to-do list’ for a character from an imaginative spoken, written or multimodal text, using information from that text, and inferring information and supplying evidence to support inferences, for example, if a character’s dream is to win at the Olympics: Προπόνηση για 2 ώρες την ημέρα, Υγιεινή διατροφή

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10CM05 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: apply strategies to interpret and respond to non-verbal, spoken and written interactions and produce texts to convey meaning and intercultural understanding in familiar and unfamiliar contexts
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Mediating meaning in and between languages

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining and interpreting idiomatic expressions such as Πέρα βρέχει, including expressions that cannot be translated literally, for example, Tα έκανα θάλασσα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing colloquial language and culturally-specific concepts used in Australia (e.g. ‘no worries’, ‘the bush’, ‘outback’ or ‘waterhole’) and comparing with Greek expressions (e.g. έλα, παιδάκι, μου, καλέ), and discussing what colloquial language represents about culture and identity

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: evaluating information from different sources for relevance, cultural appropriateness and significance, for example, facts from a reliable website versus examples from teacher-curated social media or word-of-mouth; examining culturally-specific terms such as το παλικάρι, η λεβεντιά, το φιλότιμο, το κέφι, developing appropriate explanations and discussing possible equivalent terms in English

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: translating public signs, notices and slogans, comparing each other’s versions and considering reasons for any similarities or differences between translations such as use of different methods or various interpretations, for example, Μην πατάτε το πράσινο for ‘Keep off the grass’

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: being aware of ‘false friends’ and how these may lead to confusion or hinder translation (e.g. κόσμος sounds like ‘cosmos’, which in English is outer space but in Greek this word means ‘world’; λιμάνι pronounced ‘limáni’, sounds like it might mean ‘lemon’, but actually means ‘port’) and keeping a word bank of these for reference

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: adapting a text for a different purpose, keeping the original information or intent, for example, rewording a formal email from the principal to create an informal text message for their friend, summarising the key points, such as Όλοι οι μαθητές πρέπει να φοράνε στολή κατά τη διάρκεια των εξετάσεων versus Απίστευτο, αλλά φοράμε στολή στις εξετάσεις!

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM05-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing a journal entry or a contribution for a school newsletter in Greek, reflecting on a visit to an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander Country or Place, and, with permission, referring to cultural knowledge of the site’s significance

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAC1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander societies are diverse and have distinct cultural expressions, such as language, customs and beliefs. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have the right to maintain, control, protect and develop their cultural expressions, while also maintaining the right to control, protect and develop culture as Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10CM06 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: create and present spoken and written texts, selecting vocabulary, expressions, grammatical structures and textual conventions for familiar and some unfamiliar contexts and purposes, to engage different audiences

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: working in pairs to write a text message or ‘comment’ on a or secure, teacher-moderated social media platform, experimenting with handles (@) and hashtags (#), for example, Πώς είναι ο καιρός; #ηλιόλουστος, Σώσε τον πλανήτη μας! #ανακύκλωση

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing a recipe and procedure for a fusion dish in Greek with footnotes in English about the ingredients and flavours, for example, ελληνικά τάκος, φέτα Ηπείρου με βετζεμάιτ, πατάτες τηγανιτές με φύκια, λουκουμάδες με μερέντα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: presenting information about cultural events in different formats such as captioned photographs, digital presentation or emails, for example, a digital presentation about the Antipodes festival, traditional dance performances and costumes

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a print or digital advertisement or travel brochure in Greek for travel to an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander Country or Place, including what to see and do, traditional and/or cultural considerations, means of travel, best time of year to visit, what to bring and what to wear

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPACP1
organising_ideas.text: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities of Australia maintain a deep connection to, and responsibility for, Country and Place and have holistic values and belief systems that are connected to the land, sea, sky and waterways.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: illustrating and captioning imaginative stories or characters in different formats such as cartoons or photo stories, using descriptive and expressive language (e.g. Η παρέα μου), or using other devices such as alliteration or similes and metaphors (e.g. άσπρος σαν το χιόνι, κολυμπά σαν δελφίνι, κρύος σαν πάγος)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing and/or narrating a diary entry for an imaginary or real character such as a person living during the period of the Greek Revolution or a Greek philosopher or mathematician, for example, Σήμερα πήραμε πίσω τη Θεσσαλονίκη. Σήμερα ανακάλυψα ότι η γη είναι επίπεδη. Εγώ, ο Πυθαγόρας, έκανα μια νέα ανακάλυψη.

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: presenting digital texts in Greek on topics such as recycling, sustainability and the ‘zero waste’ movement, school life, sports or leisure activities

organising_ideas.name: Sustainability - VC2CCPSIS2
organising_ideas.text: Sustainable patterns of living require the responsible use of resources; circular economies; maintenance of clean air, water and soils; and the restoration of healthy environments and habitats with ecological integrity.
organising_ideas.ccp: Sustainability

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: explaining a Greek custom or practice to an Australian audience, for example, Απόκριες, using appropriate language structures and supporting graphics, materials and gestures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating persuasive texts such as promotional brochures, speech scripts, infographics or video clips to encourage people from the wider community to attend an event or to recycle waste containers and materials, for example, Ανακύκλωσε σήμερα για να έχεις αύριο

organising_ideas.name: Sustainability - VC2CCPSWV2
organising_ideas.text: Worldviews are formed by different experiences at a personal, local, national and global level, and are linked to individual, community and political mandates and actions for sustainability.
organising_ideas.ccp: Sustainability

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10CM06-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating a range of texts to entertain and engage specific audiences (e.g. digital books, songs, cartoons, video clips suitable for young or new learners of Greek), or creating a new or modified versions of songs or stories, such as changing the words, introducing a new character or creating an alternate ending

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10UL01 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: apply features and conventions of spoken Greek to enhance and extend fluency, and to respond to and create a range of texts in familiar and unfamiliar contexts

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying differences in sounds such as γγ, γκ, τζ, τσ, μπ, ντ, αϊ, άι, -ασμα and using them appropriately when writing, for example, φεγγάρι, γκάζι

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: experimenting with pronunciation rules and intonation collaboratively with peers, for example, αυ, ευ, τσ, τζ, αι, ββ, λλ, ρρ, ττ, ιου, ιο/ιό, ειο/ειου, αυτή, εύκολη, by randomly selecting cards with these digraphs

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising the differences in tone and rhythm between questions, exclamations and commands, for example, Αλήθεια; Σοβαρά, Αμέσως, Ετοιμάσου γρήγορα! Τι λες! and practising raising and lowering their finger to mimic the rhythm

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising and reproducing rhythms in more complex sentences, using pauses, intonation, fillers and interjections to signal emphasis, show interest and keep the conversation flowing, for example, ναι ναι, αλήθεια

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: building fluency and accuracy of speech in relation to pitch, stress and rhythm by practising tongue twisters or challenging sentences or by recording themselves speaking Greek and reflecting on this when listening to it played back

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the role of pronunciation, rhythm and pace in creating effects and relationships in spoken texts such as songs, stories, poems and conversations, for example, in the song «Καλημέρα, τι κάνεις»

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: reciting advanced tongue twisters (or making their own) to build vocabulary and improve pronunciation, fluency and pace, for example, Πίτα σπανακόπιτα, σπανακολαδόπιτα. Πίτα σπανακόπιτα, σπανακολαδοφραγκοσυκόπιτα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL01-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using prior knowledge of Greek pronunciation to transcribe spoken text, writing down words and sentences as they hear them, predicting spelling of unfamiliar words, for example, μπαούλο, γυμνάσιο, στρουθοκάμηλος

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10UL02 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: apply understanding of context and grammatical structures to respond to and create a range of texts that include some complex structures, ideas and conventions appropriate to formality and text type

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the function of comparative and superlative adjectives, for example, πιο μεγάλος/πιο μεγάλη, μεγαλύτερος/μεγαλύτερη, ο πιο μεγάλος/η πιο μεγάλη

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding that personal pronouns can be omitted in Greek because it is implied through the verb ending, for example, Παίζουν μπάλα. Τραγουδάει ωραία. Διαβάζουμε πολλά βιβλία στις διακοπές

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using cardinal and ordinal numbers such as ένας σκύλος, δύο γάτες, τρεις καμήλες and πρώτος -η-ο, δεύτερος, τρίτος, τέταρτος, for example, when describing results of a sports event

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using prepositions and directions, for example, δεξιά, αριστερά, γύρω από, πίσω από, μπροστά από, ευθεία, when asking and giving directions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: extending understanding and use of present, past and future tenses (e.g. είμαι, ήμουν, θα είμαι, έχω, είχα, θα έχω, έπαιξα, παίζω, θα παίξω, θα παίζω), referring to the past, present and future using adverbs of time, for example, σήμερα, αύριο, χτες, μεθαύριο, προχτές, πριν λίγες μέρες when describing weekly activities

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a wider range of adjectives such as ευαίσθητος-η-ο, δυσαρεστημένος-η-ο and ευχαριστημένος-η-ο, when describing a friend’s qualities

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using possessive pronouns (e.g. μου, σου, του, της, του, μας, σας, τους, δικός μου, δική μου, δικό του), for example, η καρέκλα σας, το παντελόνι της, ο πατέρας τους, το δικό μου σκυλί, η δική μου απόφαση, ο δικός μου δρόμος

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: extending meaning by using adverbs of place, time and manner, such as εδώ, εκεί, κάπου-κάπου, πότε-πότε, εκεί που

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding the use of πολύ and πολλή and applying the correct form in texts, for example, πολύ ωραία, πολλή ώρα

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using expressions with the verb κάνω, κάνει κρύο/ζέστη, κάνω δουλειές, κάνω όνειρα, Τι κάνεις;

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E11 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using the conjunctions για να, έτσι ώστε, αν και, όμως, όταν to link and sequence ideas and develop compound sentences

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL02-E12 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: using prior knowledge of morphemes to predict the meaning and spelling of unfamiliar words, for example, auto-, bio-, demo-, -gram, hypo-, -ism, -logue, mono-, morph-, peri-, phil-, -phobia, psych-, -therm- in words such as ξενοφοβία, ψυχολόγος, περιφέρεια

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10UL03 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: reflect on and evaluate Greek texts, using metalanguage to discuss language structures and features

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing metalanguage and linguistic awareness to learn and discuss language structures and features in Greek, English and/or other languages, for example, conjugation, syntax, adverb, conjunction

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising how grammatical and vocabulary choices shade meaning and establish register, for example, the use of formal or informal pronouns εσύ, εσείς; the use of forms of address κύριος, κυρία, δεσποινίδα; the use of abbreviations such as π.χ, κτλ, ΣΚ- Σαββατοκύριακο, ΠΣΚ-Παρασκευοσαββατοκύριακο

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying knowledge of the interrelationship between context, purpose and audience to identify text type and predict the meaning of unfamiliar vocabulary and expressions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying how grammatical choices, words and images combine in a text to achieve particular intentions and effects, for example, the positioning of the reader through the use of personal pronouns, imperative verb forms and negative indicators, and emotive language and images

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing spoken and written forms of familiar types of texts in Greek and English and language functions such as spoken and written apologies or oral storytelling and written reports, noticing differences in grammatical, expressive and textual features, for example, Συγγνώμη που σε πλήγωσα με τις πράξεις μου versus Συγγνώμη

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing Greek and English versions of familiar texts, commenting on similarities and differences in structure, syntax and cultural elements, for example, the adjective preceding the noun (e.g. νόστιμο φαγητό); omission of subject and preposition (e.g. Πηγαίνω σχολείο, Πάμε Ελλάδα)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: interpreting and explaining textual conventions when using technology and secure social media in Greek

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL03-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising how Greek letters, words and morphemes are used globally in existing scientific and mathematical terms, and in the creation of new terms, for example, the universal application of Greek in the fields of mathematics, science and medicine

strand_substrands.substrand_title: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture
strand_substrands.substrand_tag: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2LMG10UL04 - Modern Greek
substrand_content_descriptions.text: reflect on and explain how identity is shaped by language(s), culture(s), beliefs, attitudes and values, and how these affect ways of communicating
substrand_content_descriptions.sub_strand: Understanding the interrelationship of language and culture

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E01 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: interacting with Greek speakers (e.g. students from a sister school, fellow travellers or guests) in secure, teacher-moderated online platforms, reflecting on how language choices might be interpreted by Greek speakers and making adjustments to convey intended meaning, taking care with use of hand gestures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E02 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: examining reactions to different perceptions and expectations around similar and different cultural practices in Greek and Australian contexts (e.g. the concept of personal space; greeting with καλό μήνα on the first day of the month; accepting and refusing offers; gift-giving; being offered food when visiting), or examining Greek cultural stereotypes that can lead to generalisations and misconceptions, for example, assumptions about typical diet; celebrations such as shouting ώπα! and smashing plates

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E03 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: listening to and/or reading examples of an Acknowledgement of Country in Greek and creating their own version that names the local Country for a Greek-speaking audience

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E04 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing an understanding of contemporary life in diverse Greek-speaking communities, for example, viewing excerpts from Greek films such as The Canary Yellow Bicycle and reflecting on similarities and differences from their own lifestyle, practices and traditions

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E05 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing elements of Greek language and culture and how they have become part of Australian lifestyles, for example, celebrations such as το Γλέντι, το Πανηγύρι; food such as τζατζίκι, γύρος, ντολμάδες; sayings such as ‘Achilles heel’ (αχίλλειος φτέρνα) and ‘Midas touch’ (το άγγιγμα του Μίδα)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E06 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing and discussing the interconnected nature of the linguistic and cultural diversity of Greek-speaking communities, and how this is also relevant to the linguistic and cultural diversity in Australia, including that of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples

organising_ideas.name: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures - VC2CCPAP1
organising_ideas.text: Australia has 2 distinct First Nations Peoples; each encompasses a diversity of nations across Australia. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples have occupied the Australian continent and adjacent islands from time immemorial.
organising_ideas.ccp: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Histories and Cultures

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E07 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and comparing the function and power of cultural representations such as symbols and stories on identity formation and contribution to a sense of national pride, for example, flags; Greek myths and legends; historical events

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E08 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: discussing how sociocultural norms related to gender may be embedded in grammatical structures, and identifying possible strategies to increase inclusivity, for example, using the passive voice (ο νέος νόμος ψηφίστηκε στη Βουλή instead of ο/η βουλευτής ψήφισε τον νέο νόμο στη Βουλή)

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E09 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: exploring how the Greek language has been influenced by English (e.g. the use of non-Greek words such as τα μπίλια instead of οι λογαριασμοί as an Australian phenomenon) and examining how technology, globalisation, migration and social media have influenced the Greek language, for example, the increased use of English words, σκανάρω, το μπλογκ, σερφάρω, γκουγκλ

elaborations.name: VC2LMG10UL04-E10 - Modern Greek
elaborations.elaboration_text: appreciating that many Greek speakers may be bilingual and use other language variations and/or dialects, and this may form part of their identity, beliefs and values, and examining and explaining variations in language use in different Greek-speaking communities and why the Greek language may vary in some aspects of vocabulary (e.g. κοπέλι sounds like κοπέλα, meaning ‘lady’, but it actually means το παιδί, το αγόρι in Cretan dialect), noting, for example, that isolation due to geographical barriers, such as mountains and the sea, led to the development of regional dialects
